# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#Chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,warning = FALSE,message = FALSE,fig.width = 8,fig.height = 5,fig.align = "center")

#Packages
library(knitr)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(writexl)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(pheatmap)
library(wesanderson)

library(circlize)

source("unified_figures.R")

#Browser for gt table export

  chromium_candidates <- c(
    unname(Sys.which(c("google-chrome","chromium","chromium-browser","chrome","msedge"))),
    "C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe",
    "C:/Program Files/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe",
    "C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe",
    "C:/Program Files (x86)/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe")

    Sys.setenv(CHROMOTE_CHROME=chromium_candidates[[1]])
  }
}

  theme(

    plot.subtitle=element_text(size=9),

```

# 1 BAP AND NO BAP FILTERS

## 1.1 Load data

```{r load-candidate-data}
path <- file.path("..","..","nextflow_integrator")

candidate_path <- file.path(path,"candidates_210826","nl40")

sge_path <- file.path(path,"sge")

#SGE data
bap1_sge <- read_tsv(file.path(sge_path,"bap1_sg1_annotated.tsv"),show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(endpoint),
    genomic_id=as.character(genomic_id),
    BAP1_function=case_when(
      SGE_functional_classification=="depleted" &
        SGE_concordance=="concordant_classification" ~ "SGE_CONFIRMED_LOF",
      SGE_functional_classification=="unchanged" ~ "SGE_UNCHANGED",
      SGE_functional_classification=="enriched" ~ "ABNORMAL_ENRICHED",
      TRUE ~ "NO_SGE_MATCH"))

#BAP1 candidates
bap1 <- read_tsv(file.path(candidate_path,"multicaller_bap1_candidates.tsv"),show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    sample=as.character(sample),
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(endpoint),
    chrom=str_remove(as.character(chrom),"^chr"),
    pos=as.character(pos),
    ref=toupper(ref),
    alt=toupper(alt)) %>%
  filter(patient!="1452",is.na(caller) | caller!="rex")

#Other candidate genes
nobap <- read_tsv(file.path(candidate_path,"multicaller_nobap_candidates.tsv"),show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    sample=as.character(sample),
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(endpoint),
    chrom=str_remove(as.character(chrom),"^chr"),
    pos=as.character(pos),
    ref=toupper(ref),
    alt=toupper(alt)) %>%
  filter(patient!="1452",is.na(caller) | caller!="rex")

#Sample sheet
samples <- read_tsv(file.path(path,"samplesheet.tsv"),show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  mutate(sample=as.character(sample),patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(endpoint)) %>%
  filter(patient!="1452") %>%
  distinct(sample,patient,endpoint)

#Remove unused columns
remove_columns <- c("analysis_group","variant_group")

nobap <- nobap %>% select(-any_of(remove_columns))
bap1 <- bap1 %>% select(-any_of(remove_columns))

#Quick checks
dim(bap1)
dim(nobap)
```

## 1.2 Biological prefilters

```{r biological-prefilters}
#EIF1AX positions
nobap <- nobap %>%
  mutate(protein_position=parse_number(as.character(protein_position)))

filtered_eif1ax <- nobap %>%
  filter(gene=="EIF1AX",is.na(protein_position) | !protein_position%in%c(2:15,70))

nobap <- nobap %>%
  filter(gene!="EIF1AX" | protein_position%in%c(2:15,70))

#Remove synonymous variants
filtered_synonymous <- nobap %>%
  filter(consequence=="synonymous_variant")

nobap <- nobap %>%
  filter(consequence!="synonymous_variant")

#Keep BAP1 SNVs and indels shorter than 10 bp
bap1 <- bap1 %>%
  mutate(
    variant_type=case_when(
      str_detect(alt,"^<.*>$") ~ "SV",
      nchar(ref)==1 & nchar(alt)==1 ~ "SNV",
      nchar(ref)>nchar(alt) ~ "DEL",
      nchar(ref)<nchar(alt) ~ "INS",
      TRUE ~ "OTHER"),
    variant_length=abs(nchar(ref)-nchar(alt))) %>%
  filter(variant_type=="SNV" | (variant_type%in%c("DEL","INS") & variant_length<10))

#Row counts
nrow(filtered_eif1ax)
nrow(filtered_synonymous)
nrow(nobap)
nrow(bap1)
```

## 1.3 Combine caller results

```{r collapse-caller-results}
#Collapse non-BAP1 calls
collapsed_nobap_variants <- nobap %>%
  group_by(patient,endpoint,variant_id,gene) %>%
  mutate(
    callers_detected=paste(sort(unique(caller)),collapse="; "),
    n_callers=n_distinct(caller),
    complete_row=!is.na(depth)+!is.na(qc_alt_molecules)+
      !is.na(qc_median_ad_variant)+!is.na(qc_median_bd_variant)) %>%
  arrange(desc(complete_row),desc(qc_alt_molecules),desc(alt_reads)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-complete_row)

#Collapse BAP1 calls
collapsed_bap1_variants <- bap1 %>%
  group_by(patient,endpoint,variant_id,gene) %>%
  mutate(
    callers_detected=paste(sort(unique(caller)),collapse="; "),
    n_callers=n_distinct(caller),
    complete_row=!is.na(depth)+!is.na(qc_alt_molecules)+
      !is.na(qc_median_ad_variant)+!is.na(qc_median_bd_variant)) %>%
  arrange(desc(complete_row),desc(qc_alt_molecules),desc(alt_reads)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-complete_row)

#Combine genes
all_variants <- bind_rows(
  collapsed_nobap_variants %>% mutate(across(everything(),as.character)),
  collapsed_bap1_variants %>% mutate(across(everything(),as.character))) %>%
  relocate(patient,endpoint,variant_id,gene,n_callers,callers_detected) %>%
  mutate(
    genomic_id=paste(chrom,pos,ref,alt,sep="_"),
    caller_af_percent=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(af_percent)),
    molecular_vaf_percent=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(qc_vaf_percent)))

#Check SGE duplicates
bap1_sge %>%
  count(patient,endpoint,genomic_id) %>%
  filter(n>1)

#Prepare SGE annotation
bap1_sge_merge <- bap1_sge %>%
  select(patient,endpoint,genomic_id,starts_with("SGE_"),BAP1_function)
#Add SGE annotation
all_variants <- all_variants %>%
  left_join(bap1_sge_merge,by=c("patient","endpoint","genomic_id"))

#Check BAP1 calls
all_variants %>%
  filter(gene=="BAP1") %>%
  count(BAP1_function)

#Check confirmed loss-of-function calls
all_variants %>%
  filter(gene=="BAP1",BAP1_function=="SGE_CONFIRMED_LOF") %>%
  count(SGE_functional_classification,SGE_concordance)
```

## 1.4 Coverage and REX QC

```{r coverage-rex-qc}
all_variants <- all_variants %>%
  mutate(
    depth=as.numeric(depth),
    rex_total_reads=as.numeric(rex_total_reads),
    rex_alt_reads=as.numeric(rex_alt_reads),
    filter_1=case_when(
      callers_detected=="rex" &
        (rex_total_reads<=500 | rex_alt_reads==0) ~ 1,
      callers_detected!="rex" &
        (depth<=500 | rex_total_reads<=500 | rex_alt_reads==0) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0))

#Independent result
filter_1_fail <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_1==1)
filter_1_pass <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_1==0)

nrow(filter_1_fail)
nrow(filter_1_pass)
```

## 1.5 BAP1 recurrence

```{r bap1-recurrence-filter}
all_variants <- all_variants %>%
  mutate(n_callers=as.numeric(n_callers),qc_alt_molecules=as.numeric(qc_alt_molecules)) %>%

  group_by(gene,variant_id) %>%
  mutate(n_patients_variant=n_distinct(patient[filter_1==0])) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  group_by(patient,gene,variant_id) %>%
  mutate(persistent_BL_END= gene=="BAP1" & n_distinct(endpoint[filter_1==0])==2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  mutate(
    support_class=case_when(
      gene!="BAP1" ~ "NOT_BAP1",
      n_callers>=2 & qc_alt_molecules>=2 ~ "MULTICALLER_2PLUS_MOLECULES",
      n_callers==1 & qc_alt_molecules>=2 ~ "SINGLECALLER_2PLUS_MOLECULES",
      n_callers>=2 & qc_alt_molecules==1 ~ "MULTICALLER_1_MOLECULE",
      n_callers==1 & qc_alt_molecules==1 ~ "SINGLECALLER_1_MOLECULE",
      TRUE ~ "OTHER"),

    recurrence_class=case_when(
      gene!="BAP1" ~ "NOT_BAP1",
      n_patients_variant==1 ~ "UNIQUE",
      n_patients_variant==2 ~ "TWO_PATIENTS",
      n_patients_variant>=3 ~ "SUPER_RECURRENT",
      TRUE ~ "OTHER"),

    filter_2_flag=case_when(
      gene!="BAP1" ~ "NOT_BAP1",

      recurrence_class=="SUPER_RECURRENT" &
        support_class=="SINGLECALLER_1_MOLECULE" ~ "FAIL_RECURRENT_WEAK",

      recurrence_class=="SUPER_RECURRENT" ~ "REVIEW_RECURRENT_SUPPORTED",

      recurrence_class=="TWO_PATIENTS" &
        support_class=="SINGLECALLER_1_MOLECULE" ~ "REVIEW_TWO_PATIENTS_WEAK",

      recurrence_class=="TWO_PATIENTS" ~ "REVIEW_TWO_PATIENTS_SUPPORTED",

      recurrence_class=="UNIQUE" &
        support_class=="SINGLECALLER_1_MOLECULE" ~ "KEEP_UNIQUE_WEAK",

      recurrence_class=="UNIQUE" ~ "KEEP_UNIQUE_SUPPORTED",

      TRUE ~ "REVIEW"),

    filter_2=ifelse(filter_2_flag=="FAIL_RECURRENT_WEAK",1,0))

#Independent result
filter_2_fail <- all_variants %>%
  filter(filter_2==1)

filter_2_pass <- all_variants %>%
  filter(filter_2==0)

#Sequential result
filter_2_seq_fail <- all_variants %>%
  filter(filter_1==0,filter_2==1)
filter_2_seq_pass <- all_variants %>%
  filter(filter_1==0,filter_2==0)

#Counts
nrow(filter_2_fail)
nrow(filter_2_pass)
nrow(filter_2_seq_fail)
nrow(filter_2_seq_pass)
#BAP1 filter groups
all_variants %>%
  filter(gene=="BAP1",filter_1==0) %>%
  count(filter_2_flag,sort=TRUE)
```

## 1.6 Molecular-support QC

```{r molecule-support-qc}
#Require one molecule and median AD/BD of at least 2
all_variants <- all_variants %>%
  mutate(
    qc_alt_molecules=as.numeric(qc_alt_molecules),
    qc_median_ad_variant=as.numeric(qc_median_ad_variant),
    qc_median_bd_variant=as.numeric(qc_median_bd_variant),
    filter_3=ifelse(
      is.na(qc_alt_molecules) | is.na(qc_median_ad_variant) | is.na(qc_median_bd_variant) |
      qc_alt_molecules<1 | qc_median_ad_variant<2 | qc_median_bd_variant<2,1,0))

#Independent result
filter_3_fail <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_3==1)
filter_3_pass <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_3==0)

#Sequential result
filter_3_seq_fail <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==1)

filter_3_seq_pass <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0)

#Counts
nrow(filter_3_fail)
nrow(filter_3_pass)
nrow(filter_3_seq_fail)
nrow(filter_3_seq_pass)
```

## 1.7 BAP1 checkpoint

```{r bap1-checkpoint}
bap1_filter_summary <- bind_rows(
  all_variants %>% filter(gene=="BAP1") %>% count(BAP1_function,variant_type,name="n") %>% mutate(stage="Starting"),
  all_variants %>% filter(gene=="BAP1",filter_1==0) %>% count(BAP1_function,variant_type,name="n") %>% mutate(stage="Coverage/REX QC check"),
  all_variants %>% filter(gene=="BAP1",filter_1==0,filter_2==0) %>% count(BAP1_function,variant_type,name="n") %>% mutate(stage="BAP1 recurrence filter"),
  all_variants %>% filter(gene=="BAP1",filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0) %>% count(BAP1_function,variant_type,name="n") %>% mutate(stage="Molecular-support QC check"))

#Review table
bap1_filter_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=stage,values_from=n,values_fill=0)

#Input for the non-sequential check
bap1_before_filter_4 <- all_variants %>%
  filter(gene=="BAP1",filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0) %>%
  select(
    patient,endpoint,variant_id,variant_type,
    consequence,hgvsp,BAP1_function,
    qc_alt_molecules,
    qc_median_ad_variant,
    qc_median_bd_variant)

bap1_before_filter_4
```

## 1.8 BAP1 threshold check

```{r bap1-threshold-check}
  all_variants <- all_variants %>%
    mutate(
      bap1_sensitivity_flag = case_when(
        gene == "BAP1" &
          qc_alt_molecules == 1 &
          (
            is.na(qc_median_ad_variant) |
            is.na(qc_median_bd_variant) |
            qc_median_ad_variant < 5 |
            qc_median_bd_variant < 5) ~ 1L,
        TRUE ~ 0L))

  bap1_sensitivity_population <- all_variants %>%
    filter(filter_1 == 0L,filter_2 == 0L,filter_3 == 0L,gene == "BAP1",qc_alt_molecules == 1)

  bap1_sensitivity_fail <- bap1_sensitivity_population %>%
    filter(bap1_sensitivity_flag == 1L)

  bap1_sensitivity_pass <- bap1_sensitivity_population %>%
    filter(bap1_sensitivity_flag == 0L)

  bap1_sensitivity_counts <- tibble(
    result = c("BAP1 single-molecule variants assessed","Would fail AD/BD threshold","Would pass AD/BD threshold"),
    n = c(
      nrow(bap1_sensitivity_population),
      nrow(bap1_sensitivity_fail),
      nrow(bap1_sensitivity_pass)))

  bap1_sensitivity_counts
```

## 1.9 SF3B1 and EIF1AX support

```{r sf3b1-eif1ax-filter}
 #Require median AD and BD of at least 5
  all_variants <- all_variants %>%
    mutate(
      filter_5 = case_when(
        gene %in% c("SF3B1", "EIF1AX") &
          qc_alt_molecules == 1 &
          ( is.na(qc_median_ad_variant) |
            is.na(qc_median_bd_variant) |
            qc_median_ad_variant < 5 |
            qc_median_bd_variant < 5) ~ 1L,
        TRUE ~ 0L))

  stopifnot("filter_5" %in% names(all_variants))

  filter_5_fail <- all_variants %>%
    filter(filter_5 == 1L)

  filter_5_pass <- all_variants %>%
    filter(filter_5 == 0L)

  filter_5_seq_fail <- all_variants %>%
    filter(filter_1 == 0L,filter_2 == 0L,filter_3 == 0L,filter_5 == 1L)

  filter_5_seq_pass <- all_variants %>%
    filter(filter_1 == 0L,filter_2 == 0L,filter_3 == 0L,filter_5 == 0L)

  filter_5_counts <- tibble(
    result = c("Independent fail","Independent pass","Sequential fail","Sequential pass"),
    n = c(
      nrow(filter_5_fail),
      nrow(filter_5_pass),
      nrow(filter_5_seq_fail),
      nrow(filter_5_seq_pass)))

  filter_5_counts
```

## 1.10 BAP1 molecule support

```{r bap1-molecule-filter}
#Require median AD and BD of at least 10
all_variants <- all_variants %>%
  mutate(filter_6_status=case_when(
    gene!="BAP1" ~ "NOT_BAP1",
    qc_alt_molecules>=2 ~ "PASS_MULTIMOLECULE",
    qc_alt_molecules==1 & qc_median_ad_variant>=10 & qc_median_bd_variant>=10 ~ "PASS_SINGLE_STRONG",
    qc_alt_molecules==1 & qc_median_ad_variant>=5 & qc_median_bd_variant>=5 ~ "REVIEW_SINGLE_MOLECULE",
    TRUE ~ "FAIL_SINGLE_WEAK"),
    filter_6=case_when(filter_6_status=="REVIEW_SINGLE_MOLECULE" ~ 2L,str_detect(filter_6_status,"FAIL") ~ 1L,TRUE ~ 0L))

filter_6_fail <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_6==1)
filter_6_pass <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_6==0)
filter_6_review <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_6==2)

filter_6_seq_fail <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5==0,filter_6==1)
filter_6_seq_pass <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5==0,filter_6==0)
filter_6_seq_review <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5==0,filter_6==2)

nrow(filter_6_seq_fail)
nrow(filter_6_seq_pass)
nrow(filter_6_seq_review)
```

## 1.11 BAP1 functional evidence

```{r bap1-functional-filter}
all_variants <- all_variants %>%
  mutate(sge_status=coalesce(BAP1_function,"NO_SGE_MATCH"),
         vep_lof=str_detect(coalesce(consequence,""),"frameshift_variant|stop_gained|splice_acceptor_variant|splice_donor_variant"),
         technical_fail=filter_1==1 | filter_2==1 | filter_3==1 | filter_5==1 | filter_6==1,
         technical_review=!technical_fail & (filter_5==2 | filter_6==2),
         technical_pass=!technical_fail & !technical_review,
         technical_eligible=!technical_fail) %>%
  group_by(gene,variant_id) %>%
  mutate(n_patients_technical=n_distinct(patient[technical_eligible])) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(repetition_flag=case_when(gene!="BAP1" ~ "NOT_BAP1",n_patients_technical>=2 ~ "RECURRENT_SUPPORTED",n_patients_variant>=3 ~ "RECURRENT_BEFORE_FILTERING",n_patients_variant==2 ~ "TWO_PATIENTS_BEFORE_FILTERING",TRUE ~ "UNIQUE"),
         tier3_recurrent=gene=="BAP1" & technical_eligible & (n_patients_technical>=2 | (n_patients_variant>=2 & n_callers==1 & qc_alt_molecules==1)) & (sge_status=="SGE_CONFIRMED_LOF" | (sge_status=="NO_SGE_MATCH" & vep_lof)),
         bap1_tier=case_when(gene!="BAP1" ~ "NOT_BAP1",technical_fail ~ "FAIL",sge_status%in%c("SGE_UNCHANGED","ABNORMAL_ENRICHED") ~ "NON_LOF",tier3_recurrent ~ "TIER_3",sge_status=="SGE_CONFIRMED_LOF" ~ "TIER_1",sge_status=="NO_SGE_MATCH" & vep_lof ~ "TIER_2",TRUE ~ "NON_LOF"),
         tier_reason=case_when(gene!="BAP1" ~ "NOT_BAP1",technical_fail ~ "TECHNICAL_FAIL",sge_status%in%c("SGE_UNCHANGED","ABNORMAL_ENRICHED") ~ "SGE_NOT_LOF",tier3_recurrent & n_patients_technical>=2 ~ "RECURRENT_SUPPORTED_LOF_REVIEW",tier3_recurrent ~ "RECURRENT_WEAK_LOF_REVIEW",sge_status=="SGE_CONFIRMED_LOF" ~ "SGE_CONFIRMED_LOF",sge_status=="NO_SGE_MATCH" & vep_lof ~ "VEP_PREDICTED_LOF_NO_SGE",TRUE ~ "NO_LOF_EVIDENCE"),
         filter_7_status=case_when(gene!="BAP1" ~ "NOT_BAP1",bap1_tier=="TIER_3" ~ "REVIEW_RECURRENT",technical_review & bap1_tier%in%c("TIER_1","TIER_2") ~ "REVIEW_LOW_SUPPORT",bap1_tier=="TIER_1" ~ "KEEP_TIER_1",bap1_tier=="TIER_2" ~ "KEEP_TIER_2",TRUE ~ "FILTER_OUT"),
         filter_7=case_when(filter_7_status%in%c("REVIEW_RECURRENT","REVIEW_LOW_SUPPORT") ~ 2L,filter_7_status=="FILTER_OUT" ~ 1L,TRUE ~ 0L))

#Independent result
filter_7_fail <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_7==1)
filter_7_pass <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_7==0)
filter_7_review <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_7==2)

#Sequential result
filter_7_seq_fail <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5!=1,filter_6!=1,filter_7==1)
filter_7_seq_pass <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5==0,filter_6==0,filter_7==0)
filter_7_seq_review <- all_variants %>% filter(filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5!=1,filter_6!=1,filter_7==2)

#Final BAP1 calls
final_bap1 <- filter_7_seq_pass %>% filter(gene=="BAP1")
review_bap1 <- filter_7_seq_review %>% filter(gene=="BAP1")
filtered_out_bap1 <- filter_7_seq_fail %>% filter(gene=="BAP1")

#Counts
nrow(final_bap1)
nrow(review_bap1)
nrow(filtered_out_bap1)

all_variants %>% filter(gene=="BAP1") %>% count(filter_7_status,bap1_tier,tier_reason,sort=TRUE)

review_bap1 %>% select(patient,endpoint,variant_id,molecular_vaf_percent,n_callers,callers_detected,qc_alt_molecules,qc_median_ad_variant,qc_median_bd_variant,n_patients_variant,n_patients_technical,repetition_flag,BAP1_function,consequence,bap1_tier,tier_reason,filter_6_status,filter_7_status) %>% arrange(filter_7_status,patient)
```

## 1.12 Prognostic-gene conflicts

```{r find-prognostic-conflicts}
final_variants <- filter_7_seq_pass

#Patient-level conflicts
conflict_patients <- final_variants %>%
  filter(gene%in%c("BAP1","SF3B1","EIF1AX")) %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  summarise(genes=paste(sort(unique(gene)),collapse="; "),n_genes=n_distinct(gene),.groups="drop") %>%
  filter(n_genes>1)

#Same-timepoint conflicts
conflict_samples <- final_variants %>%
  filter(gene%in%c("BAP1","SF3B1","EIF1AX")) %>%
  group_by(patient,endpoint) %>%
  summarise(genes=paste(sort(unique(gene)),collapse="; "),n_genes=n_distinct(gene),.groups="drop") %>%
  filter(n_genes>1)

#Calls causing conflicts
conflict_review <- final_variants %>%
  semi_join(conflict_patients,by="patient") %>%
  filter(gene%in%c("BAP1","SF3B1","EIF1AX")) %>%
  select(
    patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,
    n_callers,callers_detected,
    qc_alt_molecules,
    qc_alt_forward,qc_alt_reverse,
    qc_median_ad_variant,
    qc_median_bd_variant,
    bap1_tier,tier_reason,
```

## 1.13 Manual review

### 1.13.1 Prepare the review table

```{r prepare-manual-review}
adjudication_pool <- all_variants %>%
  filter(filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5!=1,filter_6!=1,filter_7!=1)

conflict_patients <- adjudication_pool %>%
  filter(gene%in%c("BAP1","SF3B1","EIF1AX")) %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  summarise(genes=paste(sort(unique(gene)),collapse="; "),n_genes=n_distinct(gene),.groups="drop") %>%
  filter(n_genes>1)

conflict_samples <- adjudication_pool %>%
  filter(gene%in%c("BAP1","SF3B1","EIF1AX")) %>%
  group_by(patient,endpoint) %>%
  summarise(genes=paste(sort(unique(gene)),collapse="; "),n_genes=n_distinct(gene),.groups="drop") %>%
  filter(n_genes>1)

manual_review <- adjudication_pool %>%
  mutate(prognostic_conflict=patient%in%conflict_patients$patient,
         review_reason=case_when(
           gene=="BAP1" & prognostic_conflict & filter_7_status=="REVIEW_RECURRENT" ~ "CONFLICT_AND_RECURRENT",
           gene=="BAP1" & prognostic_conflict & filter_7_status=="REVIEW_LOW_SUPPORT" ~ "CONFLICT_AND_LOW_SUPPORT",
           gene%in%c("BAP1","SF3B1","EIF1AX") & prognostic_conflict ~ "PROGNOSTIC_CONFLICT",
           gene=="BAP1" & filter_7_status=="REVIEW_RECURRENT" ~ "RECURRENT_BAP1",
           gene=="BAP1" & filter_7_status=="REVIEW_LOW_SUPPORT" ~ "LOW_SUPPORT_BAP1",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(review_reason)) %>%
  select(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,review_reason,molecular_vaf_percent,n_callers,
         callers_detected,qc_alt_molecules,qc_median_ad_variant,qc_median_bd_variant,
         BAP1_function,consequence,bap1_tier,tier_reason,filter_7_status)

manual_review
write_tsv(manual_review,file.path(path,"manual_review_candidates.tsv"))
```

### 1.13.2 Apply reviewed decisions

```{r manual-adjudication}
#Rank low-support BAP1 calls
bap1_low_support_rank <- manual_review %>%
  filter(gene=="BAP1",review_reason=="LOW_SUPPORT_BAP1") %>%
  mutate(support_score=pmin(qc_median_ad_variant,qc_median_bd_variant)) %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  mutate(n_low_support=n_distinct(variant_id),best_support=max(support_score,na.rm=TRUE),
         weaker_multiple=n_low_support>1 & support_score<best_support) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,support_score,weaker_multiple)

manual_decisions <- manual_review %>%
  left_join(bap1_low_support_rank,by=c("patient","endpoint","gene","variant_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    manual_decision=case_when(
      gene=="BAP1" & review_reason=="CONFLICT_AND_LOW_SUPPORT" ~ "REMOVE",
      gene=="BAP1" & coalesce(weaker_multiple,FALSE) ~ "REMOVE",
      TRUE ~ "KEEP"),
    decision_reason=case_when(
      review_reason=="CONFLICT_AND_LOW_SUPPORT" ~ "REMOVE_CONFLICTING_LOW_SUPPORT_BAP1",
      coalesce(weaker_multiple,FALSE) ~ "REMOVE_WEAKER_OF_MULTIPLE_LOW_SUPPORT_BAP1",
      TRUE ~ "KEEP_AFTER_MANUAL_REVIEW")) %>%
  select(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,manual_decision,review_reason,decision_reason,support_score)

#Build the final dataset
final_variants <- all_variants %>%
  left_join(manual_decisions,by=c("patient","endpoint","gene","variant_id")) %>%
  mutate(auto_pass=filter_1==0 & filter_2==0 & filter_3==0 & filter_5==0 & filter_6==0 & filter_7==0,
         final_keep=(auto_pass & coalesce(manual_decision,"")!="REMOVE") | coalesce(manual_decision,"")=="KEEP",
         final_status=case_when(manual_decision=="KEEP" ~ "MANUAL_KEEP",final_keep ~ "AUTO_PASS",TRUE ~ "NOT_FINAL")) %>%
  filter(final_keep) %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,.keep_all=TRUE) %>%
  arrange(patient,endpoint,gene)

filtered_final_candidates <- final_variants

#Checks
conflict_patients
conflict_samples
manual_review %>%
  left_join(select(manual_decisions,-review_reason),by=c("patient","endpoint","gene","variant_id")) %>%
  select(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,review_reason,manual_decision,decision_reason,support_score)

nrow(final_variants)
final_variants %>% count(gene,sort=TRUE)
final_variants %>% select(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,molecular_vaf_percent,n_callers,callers_detected,qc_alt_molecules,final_status)
```

## 1.15 Candidate-count reconciliation

```{r candidate-count-reconciliation, fig.width=13, fig.height=6}
#Read columns used in the audit
audit_bap1 <- read_tsv(file.path(candidate_path,"multicaller_bap1_candidates.tsv"),show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    source="BAP1",
    sample=as.character(sample),
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)),
    gene=as.character(gene),
    variant_id=as.character(variant_id),
    caller=as.character(caller),
    ref=toupper(as.character(ref)),
    alt=toupper(as.character(alt)),
    consequence=as.character(consequence),
    protein_position=parse_number(as.character(protein_position)))

audit_nobap <- read_tsv(file.path(candidate_path,"multicaller_nobap_candidates.tsv"),show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    source="Non-BAP1",
    sample=as.character(sample),
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)),
    gene=as.character(gene),
    variant_id=as.character(variant_id),
    caller=as.character(caller),
    ref=toupper(as.character(ref)),
    alt=toupper(as.character(alt)),
    consequence=as.character(consequence),
    protein_position=parse_number(as.character(protein_position)))

audit_call_key <- c("patient","endpoint","gene","variant_id")

#Compare candidate files
source_file_names <- c("multicaller_bap1_candidates.tsv","multicaller_nobap_candidates.tsv")
comparison_candidate_path <- file.path(path,"candidates_210826","final_merged")
current_source_files <- file.path(candidate_path,source_file_names)
comparison_source_files <- file.path(comparison_candidate_path,source_file_names)

stopifnot(all(file.exists(c(current_source_files,comparison_source_files))))

source_identity_audit <- tibble(
  file=source_file_names,
  current_bytes=as.numeric(file.size(current_source_files)),
  comparison_bytes=as.numeric(file.size(comparison_source_files)),
  current_md5=unname(tools::md5sum(current_source_files)),
  comparison_md5=unname(tools::md5sum(comparison_source_files))) %>%
  mutate(identical_copy=current_md5==comparison_md5)

stopifnot(all(source_identity_audit$identical_copy))

#REX contributes read support only
candidate_audit_raw <- bind_rows(audit_bap1,audit_nobap) %>%
  filter(is.na(caller) | caller!="rex")

#Apply the cohort exclusion
candidate_audit_eligible <- candidate_audit_raw %>%
  filter(patient!="1452")

#Repeat the biological prefilters
audit_bap1_prefiltered <- candidate_audit_eligible %>%
  filter(source=="BAP1") %>%
  mutate(
    variant_type=case_when(
      str_detect(alt,"^<.*>$") ~ "SV",
      nchar(ref)==1 & nchar(alt)==1 ~ "SNV",
      nchar(ref)>nchar(alt) ~ "DEL",
      nchar(ref)<nchar(alt) ~ "INS",
      TRUE ~ "OTHER"),
    variant_length=abs(nchar(ref)-nchar(alt))) %>%
  filter(variant_type=="SNV" | (variant_type%in%c("DEL","INS") & variant_length<10))

audit_nobap_prefiltered <- candidate_audit_eligible %>%
  filter(source=="Non-BAP1") %>%
  filter(gene!="EIF1AX" | protein_position%in%c(2:15,70)) %>%
  filter(consequence!="synonymous_variant")

candidate_audit_prefiltered <- bind_rows(audit_bap1_prefiltered,audit_nobap_prefiltered)

eligible_call_keys <- candidate_audit_eligible %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id)

prefiltered_call_keys <- candidate_audit_prefiltered %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id)

pipeline_call_keys <- all_variants %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id)

#Stop if the audit and pipeline differ
stopifnot(
  nrow(anti_join(prefiltered_call_keys,pipeline_call_keys,by=audit_call_key))==0L,
  nrow(anti_join(pipeline_call_keys,prefiltered_call_keys,
                 by=audit_call_key))==0L)

#Record prefilter reasons
prefilter_exclusions <- candidate_audit_eligible %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,.keep_all=TRUE) %>%
  anti_join(prefiltered_call_keys,by=audit_call_key) %>%
  mutate(
    exclusion_reason=case_when(
      source=="BAP1" ~ "BAP1 structural variant or indel >=10 bp",
      gene=="EIF1AX" &
        (is.na(protein_position) | !protein_position%in%c(2:15,70)) ~
        "EIF1AX outside retained protein positions",
      consequence=="synonymous_variant" ~
        "Synonymous non-BAP1 variant",
      TRUE ~ "Other prefilter reason"))

prefilter_reason_reference <- tibble(
  exclusion_reason=c(
    "BAP1 structural variant or indel >=10 bp",
    "EIF1AX outside retained protein positions",
    "Synonymous non-BAP1 variant",
    "Other prefilter reason"),
  reason_order=1:4)

prefilter_reason_summary <- prefilter_reason_reference %>%
  left_join(prefilter_exclusions %>% count(exclusion_reason,name="distinct_calls_removed"),by="exclusion_reason") %>%
  mutate(distinct_calls_removed=replace_na(distinct_calls_removed,0L)) %>%
  arrange(reason_order) %>%
  select(-reason_order)

#Assign the first failed stage
final_call_keys <- final_variants %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id)

filter_removal_audit <- all_variants %>%
  left_join(manual_decisions %>% select(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,decision_reason),by=audit_call_key) %>%
  mutate(
    retained_final=paste(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,sep="|") %in%
      paste(final_call_keys$patient,final_call_keys$endpoint,final_call_keys$gene,final_call_keys$variant_id,sep="|"),
    removal_step=case_when(
      filter_1==1 ~ "Coverage/REX QC check",
      filter_2==1 ~ "BAP1 recurrence filter",
      filter_3==1 ~ "Molecular-support QC check",
      filter_5==1 ~ "SF3B1/EIF1AX support filter",
      filter_6==1 ~ "BAP1 molecule-support filter",
      filter_7==1 ~ "BAP1 functional-evidence filter",
      !retained_final ~ "Manual adjudication",
      TRUE ~ "Retained"),
    removal_reason=case_when(
      filter_1==1 ~ "Coverage or REX-support requirement not met",
      filter_2==1 ~ "Recurrent weak BAP1 call",
      filter_3==1 ~ "Independent-molecule or AD/BD support not met",
      filter_5==1 ~ "Weak single-molecule SF3B1/EIF1AX call",
      filter_6==1 ~ "Weak single-molecule BAP1 call",
      filter_7==1 & tier_reason=="SGE_NOT_LOF" ~
        "BAP1 SGE result did not indicate loss of function",
      filter_7==1 & tier_reason=="NO_LOF_EVIDENCE" ~
        "No retained BAP1 loss-of-function evidence",
      filter_7==1 ~ "BAP1 functional retention rule not met",
      !retained_final &
        decision_reason=="REMOVE_CONFLICTING_LOW_SUPPORT_BAP1" ~
        "Conflicting low-support BAP1 call",
      !retained_final &
        decision_reason=="REMOVE_WEAKER_OF_MULTIPLE_LOW_SUPPORT_BAP1" ~
        "Weaker of multiple low-support BAP1 calls",
      !retained_final ~ "Not retained after final adjudication",
      TRUE ~ "Retained"))

removal_step_levels <- c(
  "Coverage/REX QC check",
  "BAP1 recurrence filter",
  "Molecular-support QC check",
  "SF3B1/EIF1AX support filter",
  "BAP1 molecule-support filter",
  "BAP1 functional-evidence filter",
  "Manual adjudication")

removal_reason_summary <- filter_removal_audit %>%
  filter(removal_step!="Retained") %>%
  count(removal_step,gene,removal_reason,name="distinct_calls_removed") %>%
  mutate(removal_step=factor(removal_step,levels=removal_step_levels)) %>%
  arrange(removal_step,gene,removal_reason)

#Reconcile automatic and manual passes
final_retention_summary <- final_variants %>%
  mutate(
    retention_basis=if_else(
      auto_pass,
      "Passed all automatic QC checks and filters",
      "Added after manual review")) %>%
  count(retention_basis,name="final_calls")

manual_retention_exception <- final_variants %>%
  filter(!auto_pass) %>%
  transmute(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,filter_6_status,filter_7_status,review_reason,decision_reason)

stopifnot(sum(final_retention_summary$final_calls)==nrow(final_variants),nrow(manual_retention_exception)==1L)

#Build the candidate flow
candidate_flow <- tibble(
  stage=c(
    "Input caller rows","Eligible cohort rows","After prefilters",
    "Collapsed calls","Coverage/REX QC check","BAP1 recurrence filter",
    "Molecular-support QC check","SF3B1/EIF1AX support filter",
    "BAP1 molecule-support filter","BAP1 functional-evidence filter",
    "Manual adjudication"),
  remaining=c(
    nrow(candidate_audit_raw),
    nrow(candidate_audit_eligible),
    nrow(candidate_audit_prefiltered),
    nrow(prefiltered_call_keys),
    nrow(filter(all_variants,filter_1==0)),
    nrow(filter(all_variants,filter_1==0,filter_2==0)),
    nrow(filter(all_variants,filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0)),
    nrow(filter(all_variants,filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5==0)),
    nrow(filter(all_variants,filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5==0,filter_6!=1)),
    nrow(filter(all_variants,filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5==0,filter_6!=1,filter_7!=1)),
    nrow(final_variants)),
  unit=c(rep("Caller rows",3),rep("Distinct calls",8))) %>%
  mutate(
    stage_index=row_number(),
    transition=case_when(
      stage_index==1 ~ NA_character_,
      stage=="Collapsed calls" ~ "Caller consolidation",
      remaining==lag(remaining) ~ "No calls removed",
      TRUE ~ "Excluded by QC/filter"))

flow_segments <- candidate_flow %>%
  transmute(x=stage_index,y=remaining,xend=lead(stage_index),yend=lead(remaining),transition=lead(transition)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(xend))

prefilter_calls_removed <- nrow(eligible_call_keys)-nrow(prefiltered_call_keys)

candidate_reconciliation <- candidate_flow %>%
  mutate(
    before=lag(remaining),
    change=case_when(
      stage_index==1 ~ NA_character_,
      stage=="Collapsed calls" ~
        paste0(before-remaining," caller rows consolidated"),
      before==remaining ~ "0 calls removed",
      unit=="Caller rows" ~ paste0(before-remaining," caller rows removed"),
      TRUE ~ paste0(before-remaining," calls removed")),
    explanation=case_when(
      stage=="Eligible cohort rows" ~ "Patient 1452 excluded by cohort rule",
      stage=="After prefilters" ~ paste0(
        prefilter_calls_removed,
        " distinct calls removed by BAP1 size, EIF1AX-position and synonymous rules"),
      stage=="Collapsed calls" ~
        "Repeated caller support combined; no additional biological call removed",
      stage=="Coverage/REX QC check" ~
        "Coverage and REX-support technical check",
      stage=="BAP1 recurrence filter" ~
        "Recurrent weak-BAP1 exclusion filter",
      stage=="Molecular-support QC check" ~
        "Independent-molecule and AD/BD technical check",
      stage=="SF3B1/EIF1AX support filter" ~
        "SF3B1/EIF1AX single-molecule filter",
      stage=="BAP1 molecule-support filter" ~
        "BAP1 single-molecule support filter",
      stage=="BAP1 functional-evidence filter" ~
        "BAP1 loss-of-function retention rule",
      stage=="Manual adjudication" ~ "Manual conflict adjudication",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(stage_index>1) %>%
  transmute(step=stage,before,after=remaining,change,explanation)

candidate_reconciliation_gt <- candidate_reconciliation %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(step="Stage",before="Before",after="After",change="Change",explanation="What happened") %>%
  tab_header(
    title="Complete reconciliation of candidate counts",
    subtitle="Caller rows are used before collapse; distinct calls are used after collapse") %>%
  cols_align("center",columns=c(before,after)) %>%

source_identity_gt <- source_identity_audit %>%

prefilter_reason_gt <- prefilter_reason_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(exclusion_reason="Prefilter reason",distinct_calls_removed="Distinct calls removed") %>%
  tab_header(title="Why eligible calls were removed before caller collapse") %>%

removal_reason_gt <- removal_reason_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    removal_step="First removal stage",gene="Gene",

final_retention_gt <- final_retention_summary %>%

manual_retention_exception_gt <- manual_retention_exception %>%

p_candidate_flow <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data=flow_segments,aes(x=x,y=y,xend=xend,yend=yend,colour=transition,linetype=transition),linewidth=.9) +
```

## 1.16 Sequential QC and filtering

```{r qc-filtering-summary}
filter_rules <- tribble(
  ~stage,~rule,
  "Input candidates","Candidates remaining after pre-filtering",
  "Coverage/REX QC check","Depth >500 with REX total reads >500 and REX ALT support",
  "BAP1 recurrence filter","Remove recurrent weak BAP1 calls supported by one caller and one ALT molecule",
  "Molecular-support QC check",">=1 independent ALT molecule with median AD and BD >=2",
  "SF3B1/EIF1AX support filter","Single-molecule calls require median AD and BD >=5",
  "BAP1 molecule-support filter","Single-molecule calls require AD and BD >=10; values 5-9 require review",
  "BAP1 functional-evidence filter","Retain technically supported SGE-confirmed or VEP-predicted BAP1 LOF calls",
  "Manual adjudication","Remove conflicting low-support BAP1 calls and the weaker of multiple low-support BAP1 calls in one patient")

stage_data <- list(
  "Input candidates"=all_variants,
  "Coverage/REX QC check"=filter(all_variants,filter_1==0),
  "BAP1 recurrence filter"=filter(all_variants,filter_1==0,filter_2==0),
  "Molecular-support QC check"=filter(all_variants,filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0),
  "SF3B1/EIF1AX support filter"=filter(all_variants,filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5==0),
  "BAP1 molecule-support filter"=filter(all_variants,filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5==0,filter_6!=1),
  "BAP1 functional-evidence filter"=filter(all_variants,filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5==0,filter_6!=1,filter_7!=1),
  "Manual adjudication"=final_variants)

filter_summary <- imap_dfr(stage_data,~count(.x,gene,name="remaining") %>% mutate(stage=.y)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=gene,values_from=remaining,values_fill=0) %>%
  right_join(filter_rules,by="stage") %>%
  mutate(stage=factor(stage,levels=filter_rules$stage)) %>%
  arrange(stage) %>%
  mutate(total=rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))),removed=lag(total)-total) %>%
  relocate(stage,rule,total,removed)

filter_summary %>%
  mutate(removed=replace_na(removed,0L)) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(stage="Stage",rule="Rule or criterion",total="Remaining",removed="Removed at stage") %>%
  tab_header(title="Sequential variant QC and filtering summary",
             subtitle="The BAP1 threshold sensitivity check was not applied sequentially")
```

```{r supplementary-filtering-criteria, include=FALSE}
  ~filter,~criterion,~action,

  "Exclude recurrent weak calls; otherwise retain or review.",

  "Pass or exclude.",

Recurrent LOF and technically low-support LOF calls enter review. SGE-unchanged, SGE-enriched and calls without LOF evidence are excluded.",
  "Retain, review or exclude.")

supplementary_filtering_criteria_gt <- supplementary_filtering_criteria %>%
```

## 1.17 BAP1 support sensitivity

```{r bap1-molecule-support-sensitivity}
filter6_thresholds <- c(5,7,10,15)

bap1_filter6_population <- all_variants %>%
  filter(gene=="BAP1",filter_1==0,filter_2==0,filter_3==0,filter_5==0,
         sge_status=="SGE_CONFIRMED_LOF" | (sge_status=="NO_SGE_MATCH" & vep_lof)) %>%
  mutate(call_id=paste(patient,endpoint,variant_id,sep="|"))

filter6_sensitivity <- crossing(threshold=filter6_thresholds,bap1_filter6_population) %>%
  mutate(pass_filter6=qc_alt_molecules>=2 |
           (qc_alt_molecules==1 & qc_median_ad_variant>=threshold & qc_median_bd_variant>=threshold),
         current_pass=qc_alt_molecules>=2 |
           (qc_alt_molecules==1 & qc_median_ad_variant>=10 &
              qc_median_bd_variant>=10))

filter6_summary <- filter6_sensitivity %>%
  group_by(threshold) %>%
  summarise(calls=sum(pass_filter6),patients=n_distinct(patient[pass_filter6]),
            variants=n_distinct(variant_id[pass_filter6]),
            gained_vs_current=sum(pass_filter6 & !current_pass),
            lost_vs_current=sum(!pass_filter6 & current_pass),.groups="drop")

filter6_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(threshold="Minimum AD and BD",calls="BAP1 calls retained",
             patients="Patients",variants="Unique variants",
             gained_vs_current="Gained vs current",lost_vs_current="Lost vs current") %>%
  tab_header(title="BAP1 sensitivity to the molecule-support threshold",
             subtitle="The current BAP1 single-molecule pass threshold is AD >=10 and BD >=10")

filter6_changes <- filter6_sensitivity %>%
  filter(threshold!=10,pass_filter6!=current_pass) %>%
  transmute(threshold,change=if_else(pass_filter6,"GAINED","LOST"),patient,
            endpoint,variant_id,qc_alt_molecules,qc_median_ad_variant,
            qc_median_bd_variant,n_callers,callers_detected,BAP1_function,consequence) %>%
  arrange(threshold,change,patient,endpoint)

filter6_changes
```

## 1.18 Filtering pathway heatmap

```{r postcalling-qc-filtering-heatmap, fig.width=18, fig.height=7, dpi=600, include=FALSE}
if(!exists("final_variants")) stop("Run final adjudication first.")

final_call_ids <- final_variants %>%
  transmute(call_id=paste(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,sep="|")) %>%
  pull(call_id)

filter_paths <- all_variants %>%
  transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(endpoint),gene,variant_id,
            mutation=case_when(!is.na(hgvsp) & !hgvsp%in%c("",".","-")~str_remove(hgvsp,"^.*:"),
                               !is.na(hgvsc) & !hgvsc%in%c("",".","-")~str_remove(hgvsc,"^.*:"),
                               TRUE~variant_id),
            call_id=paste(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,sep="|"),
            across(c(filter_1,filter_2,filter_3,filter_5,filter_6,filter_7))) %>%
  distinct(call_id,.keep_all=TRUE) %>%
  mutate(final_keep=call_id%in%final_call_ids,
         removal_step=case_when(
           filter_1==1~"Coverage/REX QC check",
           filter_2==1~"BAP1 recurrence filter",
           filter_3==1~"Molecular-support QC check",
           filter_5==1~"SF3B1/EIF1AX support filter",
           filter_6==1~"BAP1 molecule-support filter",
           filter_7==1~"BAP1 functional-evidence filter",
           !final_keep~"Manual adjudication",
           TRUE~"Retained"),
         label=make.unique(paste0(patient," ",endpoint,"\n",gene," ",mutation)))

prior_fail <- function(...) Reduce(`|`,lapply(list(...),function(x) x==1))
filter_status <- filter_paths %>%
  transmute(call_id,
            `Input`="Entered",
            `Coverage/REX QC check`=if_else(filter_1==1,"Removed","Passed"),
            `BAP1 recurrence filter`=case_when(filter_1==1~"Not reached",filter_2==1~"Removed",TRUE~"Passed"),
            `Molecular-support QC check`=case_when(prior_fail(filter_1,filter_2)~"Not reached",filter_3==1~"Removed",TRUE~"Passed"),
            `SF3B1/EIF1AX support filter`=case_when(prior_fail(filter_1,filter_2,filter_3)~"Not reached",filter_5==1~"Removed",TRUE~"Passed"),
            `BAP1 molecule-support filter`=case_when(prior_fail(filter_1,filter_2,filter_3,filter_5)~"Not reached",
                                                     filter_6==1~"Removed",filter_6==2~"Review",TRUE~"Passed"),
            `BAP1 functional-evidence filter`=case_when(prior_fail(filter_1,filter_2,filter_3,filter_5,filter_6)~"Not reached",
                                                        filter_7==1~"Removed",filter_7==2~"Review",TRUE~"Passed"),
            `Manual adjudication`=case_when(prior_fail(filter_1,filter_2,filter_3,filter_5,filter_6,filter_7)~"Not reached",
                                            final_keep~"Retained",TRUE~"Removed"))

step_levels <- c(
  "Coverage/REX QC check","BAP1 recurrence filter",
  "Molecular-support QC check","SF3B1/EIF1AX support filter",
  "BAP1 molecule-support filter","BAP1 functional-evidence filter",
  "Manual adjudication","Retained")
#Group detailed filters into four stages
collapse_filter_stage <- function(data,columns) {
  stage_matrix <- as.matrix(data[,columns,drop=FALSE])
  apply(stage_matrix,1,function(stage_status) {
    if(any(stage_status=="Removed",na.rm=TRUE)) return("Removed")
    if(any(stage_status=="Retained",na.rm=TRUE)) return("Retained")
    if(any(stage_status=="Review",na.rm=TRUE)) return("Review")
    if(any(stage_status=="Passed",na.rm=TRUE)) return("Passed")
    if(any(stage_status=="Entered",na.rm=TRUE)) return("Entered")
    "Not reached"
  })
}

filter_stage_summary <- tibble(
  call_id=filter_status$call_id,
  `Technical QC`=collapse_filter_stage(filter_status,"Coverage/REX QC check"),
  `Molecular filtering`=collapse_filter_stage(
    filter_status,
    c(
      "BAP1 recurrence filter",
      "Molecular-support QC check",
      "SF3B1/EIF1AX support filter",
      "BAP1 molecule-support filter")),
  `Functional filtering`=collapse_filter_stage(filter_status,"BAP1 functional-evidence filter"),
  `Manual review`=collapse_filter_stage(
    filter_status,
    "Manual adjudication"))

#Group identical filtering paths
status_columns <- setdiff(names(filter_stage_summary),"call_id")
filter_stage_summary$path_key <- apply(
  as.data.frame(filter_stage_summary[,status_columns,drop=FALSE]),
  1,
  paste,
  collapse="|")

trajectory_summary <- filter_stage_summary %>%
  group_by(path_key) %>%
  summarise(calls=n(),across(all_of(status_columns),first),.groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(
    outcome=case_when(
      `Technical QC`=="Removed" ~ "Technical QC",
      `Molecular filtering`=="Removed" ~ "Molecular filtering",
      `Functional filtering`=="Removed" ~ "Functional filtering",
      `Manual review`=="Removed" ~ "Manual review",
      `Manual review`=="Retained" ~ "Retained",
      TRUE ~ "Other"),
    outcome_order=match(
      outcome,
      c(
        "Technical QC","Molecular filtering","Functional filtering",
        "Manual review","Retained","Other")),
    review_order=case_when(
      `Molecular filtering`=="Passed" ~ 1L,
      `Molecular filtering`=="Review" ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ 3L)) %>%
  arrange(outcome_order,review_order,desc(calls),path_key)

trajectory_mat <- t(as.matrix(trajectory_summary[,status_columns,drop=FALSE]))
colnames(trajectory_mat) <- paste0("Trajectory ",seq_len(nrow(trajectory_summary)))

#Count calls removed at each stage
full_status_mat <- t(as.matrix(filter_stage_summary[,status_columns,drop=FALSE]))
calls_removed_by_stage <- rowSums(full_status_mat=="Removed")

stopifnot(sum(trajectory_summary$calls)==nrow(filter_stage_summary),identical(rownames(trajectory_mat),status_columns))
status_col <- c("Not reached"="#F0F0F0","Entered"="#B9D9E8","Passed"="#79C8C2",
                "Review"="#E3B25B","Removed"="#9E4051","Retained"="#006D6F")

trajectory_top_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Calls represented`=anno_text(
    paste0("n=",trajectory_summary$calls),
    gp=gpar(fontsize=8,fontface="bold"),
    just="center",
    rot=0,
    height=unit(6,"mm")),
  annotation_name_gp=gpar(fontsize=8,fontface="bold"))

trajectory_right_annotation <- rowAnnotation(
  `Calls removed`=anno_barplot(
    calls_removed_by_stage,
    gp=gpar(fill="#9E4051",col=NA),
    border=FALSE,
    width=unit(24,"mm"),
    axis_param=list(gp=gpar(fontsize=7))),
  annotation_name_gp=gpar(fontsize=8,fontface="bold"))

filter_heatmap <- Heatmap(
  trajectory_mat,
  name="Call status",
  col=status_col,
  cluster_rows=FALSE,
  cluster_columns=FALSE,
  top_annotation=trajectory_top_annotation,
  right_annotation=trajectory_right_annotation,
  show_column_names=FALSE,
  column_names_rot=0,
  column_names_gp=gpar(fontsize=if(ncol(trajectory_mat)>10) 7 else 7.5,lineheight=.9),
  column_names_max_height=unit(16,"mm"),
  row_names_gp=gpar(fontsize=9),
  rect_gp=gpar(col="white",lwd=1),
  column_gap=unit(2,"mm"),
  heatmap_legend_param=list(
    direction="horizontal",
    nrow=1,
    title_position="leftcenter"))

figure_path<-file.path(path,"figures")
dir.create(figure_path,showWarnings=FALSE)
png(file.path(figure_path,"Supplementary_Figure_S7_filtering_pathways.png"),
    width=9,height=3.8,units="in",res=publication_dpi,bg="white")
draw(filter_heatmap,heatmap_legend_side="bottom",annotation_legend_side="bottom",padding=unit(c(8,8,8,8),"mm"))
dev.off()
filter_heatmap
```

## 1.19 Caller support and contribution

### 1.19.1 Retained-call heatmap

```{r final-caller-support-heatmap, include=FALSE}
if(!exists("final_variants")) stop("Run final adjudication first.")

sample_key <- samples %>%
  transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(endpoint),
            sample_id=str_remove(as.character(sample),"_mapped$")) %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END")) %>%
  group_by(patient,endpoint) %>%
  summarise(sample_id=paste(sort(unique(sample_id)),collapse="; "),.groups="drop")

variant_data <- final_variants %>%
  transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(endpoint),gene,variant_id,hgvsp,hgvsc,
            callers_detected=as.character(callers_detected),
            mutation=case_when(!is.na(hgvsp) & !hgvsp%in%c("",".","-")~str_remove(hgvsp,"^.*:"),
                               !is.na(hgvsc) & !hgvsc%in%c("",".","-")~str_remove(hgvsc,"^.*:"),
                               TRUE~variant_id),
            detection_id=paste(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,sep="|"),
            mutation_id=paste(gene,variant_id,sep="|")) %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END"),!is.na(callers_detected),callers_detected!="") %>%
  left_join(sample_key,by=c("patient","endpoint")) %>%
  mutate(sample_id=coalesce(sample_id,paste(patient,endpoint)),mutation_label=mutation)

caller_data <- variant_data %>%
  separate_rows(callers_detected,sep="[;,]") %>%
  mutate(caller_raw=str_to_lower(str_trim(callers_detected)),
         caller=case_when(str_detect(caller_raw,"mutect")~"Mutect2",
                          str_detect(caller_raw,"deepsomatic|deep")~"DeepSomatic",
                          str_detect(caller_raw,"pisces")~"Pisces",
                          str_detect(caller_raw,"vardict")~"VarDict",
                          str_detect(caller_raw,"varscan")~"VarScan2",
                          str_detect(caller_raw,"dream")~"DREAMS-vc",
                          TRUE~str_to_title(caller_raw))) %>%
  filter(caller!="",str_to_lower(caller)!="rex") %>%
  distinct(detection_id,caller,.keep_all=TRUE)

call_support <- caller_data %>%
  group_by(detection_id,patient,endpoint,sample_id,gene,variant_id,mutation_id,mutation_label) %>%
  summarise(n_callers=n_distinct(caller),callers=paste(sort(unique(caller)),collapse="; "),.groups="drop")
if(!nrow(call_support)) stop("No final variants contain caller-support information.")

cell_support <- call_support %>% group_by(mutation_id,sample_id) %>%
  summarise(n_callers=max(n_callers),.groups="drop")
mutation_info <- call_support %>%
  group_by(mutation_id,gene) %>%
  summarise(
    mutation_label=first(mutation_label[!is.na(mutation_label) & mutation_label!=""],default=first(variant_id)),
    n_samples=n_distinct(sample_id),
    .groups="drop") %>%
  arrange(gene,desc(n_samples),mutation_label) %>%
  mutate(mutation_rank=row_number(),plot_label=make.unique(paste(gene,mutation_label,sep=" ")))
sample_info <- call_support %>%
  distinct(sample_id,patient,endpoint) %>%
  left_join(cell_support %>% left_join(select(mutation_info,mutation_id,mutation_rank),by="mutation_id") %>%
              group_by(sample_id) %>% summarise(first_mutation=min(mutation_rank),.groups="drop"),by="sample_id") %>%
  mutate(endpoint=factor(endpoint,levels=c("BL","END")),patient_num=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(patient))) %>%
  arrange(first_mutation,is.na(patient_num),patient_num,patient,endpoint)

support_mat <- matrix(0,nrow=nrow(mutation_info),ncol=nrow(sample_info),
  dimnames=list(mutation_info$plot_label,sample_info$sample_id))
support_index <- cell_support %>%
  transmute(row=match(mutation_id,mutation_info$mutation_id),
            col=match(sample_id,sample_info$sample_id),
            n_callers=n_callers) %>%
  filter(!is.na(row),!is.na(col))
support_mat[cbind(support_index$row,support_index$col)] <- support_index$n_callers

oncoprint_calls <- caller_data %>%
  left_join(select(mutation_info,mutation_id,plot_label),by="mutation_id") %>%
  group_by(plot_label,sample_id) %>%
  summarise(callers=paste(sort(unique(caller)),collapse=";"),.groups="drop")

oncoprint_mat <- matrix("",nrow=nrow(mutation_info),ncol=nrow(sample_info),
  dimnames=list(mutation_info$plot_label,sample_info$sample_id))
oncoprint_index <- oncoprint_calls %>%
  transmute(row=match(plot_label,rownames(oncoprint_mat)),
            col=match(sample_id,colnames(oncoprint_mat)),
            callers=callers) %>%
  filter(!is.na(row),!is.na(col))
oncoprint_mat[cbind(oncoprint_index$row,oncoprint_index$col)] <- oncoprint_index$callers

non_empty_rows <- apply(oncoprint_mat,1,function(x) any(nzchar(x)))
non_empty_columns <- apply(oncoprint_mat,2,function(x) any(nzchar(x)))
if(!any(non_empty_rows) || !any(non_empty_columns)) {
  stop("No non-empty caller-support cells are available for the multicaller heatmap.")
}
oncoprint_mat <- oncoprint_mat[non_empty_rows,non_empty_columns,drop=FALSE]
support_mat <- support_mat[non_empty_rows,non_empty_columns,drop=FALSE]
mutation_info_plot <- mutation_info[non_empty_rows,,drop=FALSE]
sample_info_plot <- sample_info[non_empty_columns,,drop=FALSE]

preferred_callers <- c("Mutect2","DeepSomatic","Pisces","VarDict","VarScan2","DREAMS-vc")
caller_order <- c(preferred_callers[preferred_callers%in%caller_data$caller],
                  setdiff(sort(unique(caller_data$caller)),preferred_callers))
caller_colours <- setNames(
  c("#0072B2","#009E73","#E69F00","#CC79A7","#D55E00","#56B4E9",
    rep("#666666",max(0,length(caller_order)-6)))[seq_along(caller_order)],
  caller_order)
n_caller_types <- length(caller_order)
alter_fun <- c(
  list(background=function(x,y,w,h) {
    grid.rect(x,y,w*.96,h*.92,gp=gpar(fill="#F3F3F3",col="white",lwd=.5))
  }),
  setNames(lapply(seq_along(caller_order),function(k) {
    function(x,y,w,h) {
      grid.rect(x,y-h/2+(k-.5)*h/n_caller_types,w*.90,h/n_caller_types*.82,gp=gpar(fill=caller_colours[k],col=NA))
    }
  }),caller_order))

gene_split <- factor(mutation_info_plot$gene,levels=unique(mutation_info_plot$gene))
stopifnot(
  nrow(oncoprint_mat)==nrow(mutation_info_plot),
  ncol(oncoprint_mat)==nrow(sample_info_plot),
  length(gene_split)==nrow(oncoprint_mat))

p_caller_support <- ComplexHeatmap::oncoPrint(
  oncoprint_mat,
  get_type=function(x) {
    if(is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) character(0) else strsplit(x,";",fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
  },
  alter_fun=alter_fun,
  col=caller_colours,
  alter_fun_is_vectorized=FALSE,
  row_split=gene_split,
  row_gap=unit(1.5,"mm"),
  remove_empty_rows=FALSE,
  remove_empty_columns=FALSE,
  show_pct=FALSE,
  show_row_names=TRUE,
  row_names_gp=gpar(fontsize=8),
  show_column_names=TRUE,
  column_names_rot=90,
  column_names_gp=gpar(fontsize=7),
  row_names_max_width=unit(55,"mm"),
  column_title="Sample",
  row_title="Mutation",
  heatmap_legend_param=list(
    title="Variant caller",
    at=caller_order,
    labels=caller_order))

figure_path <- file.path(path,"figures")
dir.create(figure_path,showWarnings=FALSE)
output_file <- file.path(figure_path,"Supplementary_Figure_S8_caller_support.png")
png(output_file,width=max(11,5+.28*ncol(oncoprint_mat)),
    height=max(7,3+.30*nrow(oncoprint_mat)),
    units="in",res=publication_dpi,bg="white")
ComplexHeatmap::draw(p_caller_support,heatmap_legend_side="right")
dev.off()
ComplexHeatmap::draw(p_caller_support,heatmap_legend_side="right")

variant_support_table <- call_support %>%
  select(patient,endpoint,sample_id,gene,mutation_label,variant_id,n_callers,callers)
variant_support_table
message("Saved to: ",output_file)
```

### 1.19.2 Variant and caller tables

```{r caller-contribution-data, include=FALSE}
if(!exists("final_variants")) stop("Run final adjudication first.")
if(!exists("candidate_audit_raw")) {
  stop("Run the candidate-count reconciliation section first.")
}

normalise_caller_name <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    str_detect(x,"mutect") ~ "Mutect2",
    str_detect(x,"deepsomatic|deep") ~ "DeepSomatic",
    str_detect(x,"pisces") ~ "Pisces",
    str_detect(x,"vardict") ~ "VarDict",
    str_detect(x,"varscan") ~ "VarScan2",
    str_detect(x,"dream") ~ "DREAMS-vc",
    TRUE ~ str_to_title(x))
}

#Caller rows before consolidation
caller_row_stage_long <- bind_rows(
  candidate_audit_raw %>%
    transmute(stage="input_rows",caller=normalise_caller_name(caller)),
  candidate_audit_eligible %>%
    transmute(stage="eligible_rows",caller=normalise_caller_name(caller)),
  candidate_audit_prefiltered %>%
    transmute(stage="prefilter_rows",caller=normalise_caller_name(caller))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(caller),caller!="") %>%
  count(caller,stage,name="caller_rows")

caller_order_input <- caller_row_stage_long %>%
  filter(stage=="input_rows") %>%
  arrange(desc(caller_rows),caller) %>%
  pull(caller)

caller_row_stage_summary <- caller_row_stage_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=stage,values_from=caller_rows,values_fill=0) %>%
  arrange(match(caller,caller_order_input))

caller_row_stage_display <- bind_rows(
  caller_row_stage_summary,
  caller_row_stage_summary %>%
    summarise(
      caller="All callers",
      input_rows=sum(input_rows),
      eligible_rows=sum(eligible_rows),
      prefilter_rows=sum(prefilter_rows)))

stopifnot(
  sum(caller_row_stage_summary$input_rows)==nrow(candidate_audit_raw),
  sum(caller_row_stage_summary$eligible_rows)==
    nrow(candidate_audit_eligible),
  sum(caller_row_stage_summary$prefilter_rows)==
    nrow(candidate_audit_prefiltered))

caller_input_rows_gt <- caller_row_stage_display %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    caller="Caller",
    input_rows="Input caller rows",
    eligible_rows="Eligible cohort rows",
    prefilter_rows="Rows after prefilters") %>%
  tab_header(
    title=md("**Caller rows before consolidation**"),
    subtitle=paste0(
      "The input contains ",nrow(candidate_audit_raw),
      " caller rows; repeated support for the same call has not yet been combined")) %>%
  cols_align("left",columns=caller) %>%
  cols_align("center",columns=-caller) %>%
  tab_style(style=cell_text(weight="bold"),locations=cells_body(rows=caller=="All callers")) %>%
  tab_source_note(md(
    "*Rows are counted separately for each caller. The cohort exclusion and biological prefilters are applied before caller consolidation.*"))

#One row per call and caller
extract_caller_support <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    transmute(
      call_id=paste(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,sep="|"),
      patient=as.character(patient),
      endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)),
      gene=as.character(gene),
      variant_id=as.character(variant_id),
      callers_detected=as.character(callers_detected)) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    separate_rows(callers_detected,sep="[;,]") %>%
    mutate(caller_raw=str_to_lower(str_trim(callers_detected)),caller=normalise_caller_name(caller_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(caller_raw),caller_raw!="",caller_raw!="rex",!is.na(caller),caller!="") %>%
    distinct(call_id,caller,.keep_all=TRUE)
}

collapsed_caller_support <- extract_caller_support(all_variants)

final_caller_support <- extract_caller_support(final_variants) %>%
  group_by(call_id) %>%
  mutate(n_supporting_callers=n_distinct(caller)) %>%
  ungroup()

n_collapsed_calls <- all_variants %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id) %>%
  nrow()
n_final_calls <- final_variants %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id) %>%
  nrow()
n_final_support_observations <- nrow(final_caller_support)

stopifnot(
  n_distinct(collapsed_caller_support$call_id)==n_collapsed_calls,
  n_distinct(final_caller_support$call_id)==n_final_calls)

caller_contribution_summary <- collapsed_caller_support %>%
  count(caller,name="collapsed_calls_supported") %>%
  full_join(
    final_caller_support %>%
      group_by(caller) %>%
      summarise(
        final_calls_supported=n_distinct(call_id),
        unique_final_calls=n_distinct(call_id[n_supporting_callers==1]),
        shared_final_calls=n_distinct(call_id[n_supporting_callers>1]),
        .groups="drop"),
    by="caller") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(collapsed_calls_supported,final_calls_supported,unique_final_calls,shared_final_calls),~replace_na(.x,0L)),
    retained_from_supported_percent=if_else(
      collapsed_calls_supported>0,
      100*final_calls_supported/collapsed_calls_supported,
      NA_real_),
    final_call_coverage_percent=100*final_calls_supported/n_final_calls) %>%
  arrange(desc(final_calls_supported),desc(unique_final_calls),caller)

stopifnot(all(
  caller_contribution_summary$final_calls_supported==
    caller_contribution_summary$unique_final_calls+
    caller_contribution_summary$shared_final_calls))

caller_contribution_gt <- caller_contribution_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    caller="Caller",
    collapsed_calls_supported="Collapsed candidate calls supported",
    final_calls_supported="Final calls supported",
    unique_final_calls="Unique final calls",
    shared_final_calls="Shared final calls",
    retained_from_supported_percent="Supported candidates retained",
    final_call_coverage_percent="Final calls supported") %>%
  fmt_number(columns=c(retained_from_supported_percent,final_call_coverage_percent),decimals=1,suffix="%") %>%
  tab_header(
    title=md("**Contribution of each caller after consolidation**"),
    subtitle=paste0(
      n_collapsed_calls," collapsed candidate calls became ",
      n_final_calls," final retained calls")) %>%
  cols_align("left",columns=caller) %>%
  cols_align("center",columns=-caller) %>%
  tab_source_note(md(paste0(
    "*Counts are inclusive: a call supported by several callers appears once for each supporting caller. The ",
    n_final_calls," final calls therefore produce ",
    n_final_support_observations," caller-support observations. Unique means that no other caller supported that final call.*"))) %>%
  tab_source_note(md("*These are support and overlap counts, not estimates of sensitivity, specificity or accuracy.*"))

#One row per final caller combination
caller_combination_summary <- final_caller_support %>%
  group_by(call_id) %>%
  summarise(
    caller_combination=paste(sort(unique(caller)),collapse=" + "),
    n_callers=n_distinct(caller),
    .groups="drop") %>%
  count(caller_combination,n_callers,name="final_calls") %>%
  mutate(percent_of_final=100*final_calls/n_final_calls) %>%
  arrange(desc(final_calls),n_callers,caller_combination)

stopifnot(sum(caller_combination_summary$final_calls)==n_final_calls)

caller_combination_gt <- caller_combination_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    caller_combination="Exact caller combination",
    n_callers="Number of callers",
    final_calls="Final calls",
    percent_of_final="Final calls") %>%
  fmt_number(columns=percent_of_final,decimals=1,suffix="%") %>%
  tab_header(
    title=md("**Exact caller combinations among final retained calls**"),
    subtitle=paste0(
      "Every retained call is counted once; the Final calls column sums to ",
      n_final_calls)) %>%
  cols_align("left",columns=caller_combination) %>%
  cols_align("center",columns=-caller_combination)

#Inclusive caller support
caller_order_contribution <- caller_contribution_summary$caller

caller_stage_plot_data <- caller_contribution_summary %>%
  select(caller,`Collapsed candidates`=collapsed_calls_supported,`Final retained`=final_calls_supported) %>%
  pivot_longer(-caller,names_to="stage",values_to="calls") %>%
  mutate(
    caller=factor(caller,levels=rev(caller_order_contribution)),
    stage=factor(
      stage,
      levels=c("Collapsed candidates","Final retained")))

p_caller_stage <- ggplot(caller_stage_plot_data,aes(calls,caller,fill=stage)) +
  geom_col(position=position_dodge2(width=.76,preserve="single"),width=.68) +
  geom_text(aes(label=calls),position=position_dodge2(width=.76,preserve="single"),hjust=-.15,size=3.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("Collapsed candidates"="#8A8A8A","Final retained"="#008C95")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.15))) +
  labs(
    title=NULL,
    subtitle="Inclusive support before and after final selection",
    x="Distinct calls supported",
    y=NULL,
    fill=NULL) +
  theme_unified(base_size=10) +
  theme(legend.position="bottom")

#Unique and shared caller support
caller_support_class_data <- caller_contribution_summary %>%
  select(caller,`Unique to caller`=unique_final_calls,`Shared with other caller(s)`=shared_final_calls) %>%
  pivot_longer(-caller,names_to="support_class",values_to="calls") %>%
  mutate(
    caller=factor(caller,levels=rev(caller_order_contribution)),
    support_class=factor(
      support_class,
      levels=c("Shared with other caller(s)","Unique to caller")))

p_caller_unique_shared <- ggplot(caller_support_class_data,aes(calls,caller,fill=support_class)) +
  geom_col(width=.68) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label=if_else(calls>0,as.character(calls),"")),
    position=position_stack(vjust=.5),
    colour="white",
    fontface="bold",
    size=3.1) +
  geom_text(
    data=caller_contribution_summary %>%
      mutate(caller=factor(caller,levels=rev(caller_order_contribution))),
    aes(x=final_calls_supported,y=caller,label=final_calls_supported),
    inherit.aes=FALSE,
    hjust=-.25,
    size=3.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("Shared with other caller(s)"="#3C78A8","Unique to caller"="#D55E00")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.18))) +
  labs(
    title=NULL,
    subtitle=paste0("Unique and shared support within ",n_final_calls," final calls"),
    x="Final calls supported",
    y=NULL,
    fill=NULL) +
  theme_unified(base_size=10) +
  theme(legend.position="bottom")

#Exact caller combinations
combination_plot_data <- caller_combination_summary %>%
  mutate(
    combination_label=str_wrap(caller_combination,width=52),
    combination_label=factor(combination_label,levels=rev(combination_label)),
    n_callers=factor(n_callers))

caller_count_colours <- c("1"="#D55E00","2"="#009E73","3"="#0072B2","4"="#CC79A7","5"="#4D4D4D","6"="#8A8A8A")

p_caller_combinations <- ggplot(combination_plot_data,aes(final_calls,combination_label,fill=n_callers)) +
  geom_col(width=.68) +
  geom_text(aes(label=final_calls),hjust=-.2,size=3.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=caller_count_colours,drop=FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,max(caller_combination_summary$final_calls)+1),expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.08))) +
  labs(
    title=NULL,
    subtitle="Exact caller intersections; each final call is counted once",
    x="Final retained calls",
    y=NULL,
    fill="Callers in combination") +
  theme_unified(base_size=10) +
  theme(legend.position="bottom")

caller_contribution_panel <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  p_caller_stage,
  p_caller_unique_shared,
  p_caller_combinations,
  design="AB\nCC",
  heights=c(1,1.45)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    tag_levels="A",
    caption=paste0(
      "Calls are distinct patient-timepoint-gene-variant combinations. ",
      "Shared calls contribute to more than one caller total; therefore ",
      n_final_calls," final calls produce ",
      n_final_support_observations," caller-support observations."),
    theme=figure_tag_theme+
      theme(plot.caption=element_text(size=8,hjust=0,margin=margin(t=5))))

figure_path <- file.path(path,"figures")
dir.create(figure_path,showWarnings=FALSE)

ggsave(
  file.path(figure_path,"Figure_2_multicaller_contribution.png"),
  caller_contribution_panel,
  width=12,
  height=9.5,
  dpi=publication_dpi,
  bg="white")

caller_contribution_panel
```

```{r publication-multicaller-tables, include=FALSE}
if(!exists("candidate_audit_raw")) {
  stop("Run the candidate-count reconciliation section first.")
}

publication_caller_name <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    x=="deepsomatic" ~ "DeepSomatic",
    x=="dreams_vc" ~ "DREAMS-vc",
    x=="mutect2" ~ "Mutect2",
    x=="pisces" ~ "Pisces NL40",
    x=="vardict" ~ "VarDict",
    x=="varscan" ~ "VarScan",
    TRUE ~ str_to_title(x))
}

integrator_records <- candidate_audit_raw %>%
  transmute(
    source,
    sample=as.character(sample),
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)),
    gene=as.character(gene),
    variant_id=as.character(variant_id),
    caller_raw=str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(caller))),
    caller=publication_caller_name(caller),
    candidate_id=paste(sample,variant_id,sep="|")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample),sample!="",!is.na(variant_id),variant_id!="",!is.na(caller_raw),caller_raw!="")

candidate_support_verified <- integrator_records %>%
  group_by(candidate_id) %>%
  summarise(supporting_callers=n_distinct(caller_raw),weighted_caller_records=n(),.groups="drop")

n_integrator_records <- nrow(integrator_records)
n_sample_variant_candidates <- n_distinct(integrator_records$candidate_id)
n_unique_genomic_variants <- n_distinct(integrator_records$variant_id)
n_unique_samples <- n_distinct(integrator_records$sample)
n_unique_patients <- n_distinct(integrator_records$patient)
n_genes <- n_distinct(integrator_records$gene)
n_unique_sample_variant_caller <- integrator_records %>%
  distinct(sample,variant_id,caller_raw) %>%
  nrow()
n_within_caller_duplicates <-
  n_integrator_records-n_unique_sample_variant_caller
n_multicaller_candidates <- sum(candidate_support_verified$supporting_callers>1)
n_singlecaller_candidates <- sum(candidate_support_verified$supporting_callers==1)

verified_integrator_values <- c(
  n_integrator_records,
  n_sample_variant_candidates,
  n_integrator_records-n_sample_variant_candidates,
  n_unique_genomic_variants,
  n_unique_samples,
  n_unique_patients,
  n_genes,
  n_unique_sample_variant_caller,
  n_within_caller_duplicates,
  n_multicaller_candidates,
  n_singlecaller_candidates)

expected_integrator_values <- c(154L,110L,44L,90L,68L,43L,5L,154L,0L,22L,88L)

stopifnot(all(as.integer(verified_integrator_values)==expected_integrator_values))

compact_publication_gt <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    tab_style(style=cell_text(weight="bold"),locations=cells_column_labels()) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.font.names="Arial",
      table.font.size=10,
      table.align="left",
      data_row.padding=0,
      column_labels.padding=1,
      source_notes.font.size=8,
      source_notes.padding=1,
      table.border.top.color="black",
      table.border.bottom.color="black",
      column_labels.border.top.color="black",
      column_labels.border.bottom.color="black",
      row.striping.background_color="white")
}
```

### 1.19.3 Before and after filtering

```{r multicaller-prefilter-postfilter-comparison, fig.width=15.5, fig.height=20, dpi=600, include=FALSE}
comparison_required_objects <- c("integrator_records","final_variants","caller_colours","caller_order")
comparison_missing_objects <- comparison_required_objects[
  !vapply(
    comparison_required_objects,
    function(object_name) exists(object_name,inherits=TRUE),
    logical(1))]
if(length(comparison_missing_objects)>0L) {
  stop(
    "Run the multicaller heatmap and publication-table chunks first. Missing: ",
    paste(comparison_missing_objects,collapse=", "))
}
if(!requireNamespace("patchwork",quietly=TRUE)) {
  stop("The patchwork package is required for the multicaller comparison panel.")
}

#Reuse the caller order and colours
comparison_caller_order <- c("Mutect2","DeepSomatic","Pisces","VarDict","VarScan2","DREAMS-vc")
comparison_caller_colours <- c(
  "Mutect2"="#0072B2",
  "DeepSomatic"="#009E73",
  "Pisces"="#E69F00",
  "VarDict"="#CC79A7",
  "VarScan2"="#D55E00",
  "DREAMS-vc"="#56B4E9")

#Check the copied colour palette
existing_palette_mismatch <- names(caller_colours)[
  is.na(comparison_caller_colours[names(caller_colours)]) |
    unname(caller_colours)!=
      unname(comparison_caller_colours[names(caller_colours)])]
if(length(existing_palette_mismatch)>0L) {
  stop(
    "The copied caller palette does not match the existing heatmap for: ",
    paste(existing_palette_mismatch,collapse=", "))
}

#Use integrated records before filtering
multicaller_prefilter_records <- integrator_records %>%
  transmute(
    candidate_id=as.character(candidate_id),
    sample=as.character(sample),
    sample_label=str_remove(as.character(sample),"_mapped$"),
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)),
    gene=as.character(gene),
    variant_id=as.character(variant_id),
    mutation_id=paste(gene,variant_id,sep="|"),
    caller_raw=str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(caller_raw))),
    caller=case_when(
      caller_raw=="mutect2" ~ "Mutect2",
      caller_raw=="deepsomatic" ~ "DeepSomatic",
      caller_raw=="pisces" ~ "Pisces",
      caller_raw=="vardict" ~ "VarDict",
      caller_raw=="varscan" ~ "VarScan2",
      caller_raw=="dreams_vc" ~ "DREAMS-vc",
      TRUE ~ str_to_title(caller_raw))) %>%
  distinct(candidate_id,caller,.keep_all=TRUE)

comparison_unknown_callers <- setdiff(unique(multicaller_prefilter_records$caller),comparison_caller_order)
if(length(comparison_unknown_callers)>0L) {
  stop("Caller colours are not defined for: ",paste(comparison_unknown_callers,collapse=", "))
}

#Validate sample and variant keys
multicaller_key_conflicts <- multicaller_prefilter_records %>%
  group_by(candidate_id) %>%
  summarise(
    samples=n_distinct(sample),
    patients=n_distinct(patient),
    endpoints=n_distinct(endpoint),
    genes=n_distinct(gene),
    variants=n_distinct(variant_id),
    .groups="drop") %>%
  filter(if_any(samples:variants,~.x!=1L))

if(nrow(multicaller_key_conflicts)>0L) {
  print(multicaller_key_conflicts,n=Inf,width=Inf)
  stop("At least one sample-variant candidate key maps to inconsistent fields.")
}

summarise_multicaller_candidates <- function(records) {
  records %>%
    group_by(candidate_id) %>%
    summarise(
      sample=first(sample),
      sample_label=first(sample_label),
      patient=first(patient),
      endpoint=first(endpoint),
      gene=first(gene),
      variant_id=first(variant_id),
      mutation_id=first(mutation_id),
      supporting_callers=n_distinct(caller),
      callers=paste(comparison_caller_order[comparison_caller_order%in%unique(caller)],collapse=";"),
      .groups="drop")
}

multicaller_prefilter_support <- summarise_multicaller_candidates(multicaller_prefilter_records)

#Match final keys to prefilter caller records
multicaller_final_keys <- final_variants %>%
  transmute(
    candidate_id=paste(as.character(sample),as.character(variant_id),sep="|"),
    sample=as.character(sample),
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)),
    gene=as.character(gene),
    variant_id=as.character(variant_id)) %>%
  distinct()

multicaller_missing_final_keys <- multicaller_final_keys %>%
  anti_join(multicaller_prefilter_support %>% distinct(candidate_id),by="candidate_id")

multicaller_postfilter_records <- multicaller_prefilter_records %>%
  semi_join(multicaller_final_keys %>% distinct(candidate_id),by="candidate_id")
multicaller_postfilter_support <- summarise_multicaller_candidates(multicaller_postfilter_records)

summarise_multicaller_stage <- function(records,support,stage_name) {
  tibble(
    stage=stage_name,
    caller_records=nrow(records),
    candidate_calls=nrow(support),
    genomic_variants=n_distinct(support$variant_id),
    plasma_samples=n_distinct(support$sample),
    patients=n_distinct(support$patient))
}

multicaller_stage_validation <- bind_rows(
  summarise_multicaller_stage(multicaller_prefilter_records,multicaller_prefilter_support,"Pre-filter"),
  summarise_multicaller_stage(
    multicaller_postfilter_records,
    multicaller_postfilter_support,
    "Final retained")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-stage,names_to="metric",values_to="observed") %>%
  mutate(
    expected=case_when(
      stage=="Pre-filter" & metric=="caller_records" ~ 154L,
      stage=="Pre-filter" & metric=="candidate_calls" ~ 110L,
      stage=="Pre-filter" & metric=="genomic_variants" ~ 90L,
      stage=="Pre-filter" & metric=="plasma_samples" ~ 68L,
      stage=="Pre-filter" & metric=="patients" ~ 43L,
      stage=="Final retained" & metric=="candidate_calls" ~ 31L,
      stage=="Final retained" & metric=="genomic_variants" ~ 18L,
      stage=="Final retained" & metric=="plasma_samples" ~ 24L,
      stage=="Final retained" & metric=="patients" ~ 21L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    status=case_when(
      is.na(expected) ~ "Reported",
      observed==expected ~ "Match",
      TRUE ~ "MISMATCH"))

multicaller_key_validation <- tibble(
  metric=c(
    "Final retained candidate keys",
    "Final keys found in pre-filter source",
    "Final keys missing from pre-filter source"),
  observed=c(nrow(multicaller_final_keys),nrow(multicaller_postfilter_support),nrow(multicaller_missing_final_keys)),
  expected=c(31L,31L,0L)) %>%
  mutate(status=if_else(observed==expected,"Match","MISMATCH"))

multicaller_support_counts <- bind_rows(
  multicaller_prefilter_support %>%
    count(supporting_callers,name="candidates") %>%
    mutate(stage="Pre-filter"),
  multicaller_postfilter_support %>%
    count(supporting_callers,name="candidates") %>%
    mutate(stage="Final retained"))

multicaller_support_comparison <- tidyr::crossing(stage=c("Pre-filter","Final retained"),supporting_callers=1:5) %>%
  left_join(multicaller_support_counts,by=c("stage","supporting_callers")) %>%
  mutate(
    candidates=replace_na(candidates,0L),
    denominator=if_else(stage=="Pre-filter",110L,31L),
    percentage=100*candidates/denominator,
    stage=factor(stage,levels=c("Pre-filter","Final retained"))) %>%
  arrange(stage,supporting_callers)

#Run checks before plotting
print(multicaller_stage_validation,n=Inf,width=Inf)
print(multicaller_key_validation,n=Inf,width=Inf)
print(multicaller_support_comparison,n=Inf,width=Inf)
if(nrow(multicaller_missing_final_keys)>0L) {
  print(multicaller_missing_final_keys,n=Inf,width=Inf)
}

prefilter_support_vector <- multicaller_support_comparison %>%
  filter(stage=="Pre-filter") %>%
  arrange(supporting_callers) %>%
  pull(candidates)

comparison_validation_failed <-
  any(multicaller_stage_validation$status=="MISMATCH") |
  any(multicaller_key_validation$status=="MISMATCH") |
  !identical(as.integer(prefilter_support_vector),c(88L,8L,8L,4L,2L)) |
  sum(multicaller_prefilter_support$supporting_callers==1L)!=88L |
  sum(multicaller_prefilter_support$supporting_callers>=2L)!=22L |
  sum(multicaller_postfilter_support$supporting_callers%in%1:5)!=31L |
  any(multicaller_prefilter_support$supporting_callers>5L) |
  any(multicaller_postfilter_support$supporting_callers>5L)

if(comparison_validation_failed) {
  stop("Multicaller comparison validation failed; no panels were generated. ","Review the printed validation tables.")
```
