#Order variants and samples
format_comparison_variant <- function(variant_id) {
  variant_parts <- str_split_fixed(as.character(variant_id),"_",4)
  abbreviate_allele <- function(allele) {
    if_else(nchar(allele)>12,paste0(str_sub(allele,1,6),"...(",nchar(allele)," bp)"),allele)
  }
  paste(
    variant_parts[,1],
    variant_parts[,2],
    abbreviate_allele(variant_parts[,3]),
    abbreviate_allele(variant_parts[,4]),
    sep="_")
}

comparison_prefilter_mutations <- multicaller_prefilter_support %>%
  count(mutation_id,gene,variant_id,name="n_samples") %>%
  arrange(gene,desc(n_samples),variant_id) %>%
  mutate(
    mutation_rank=row_number(),
    display_variant=format_comparison_variant(variant_id),
    plot_label=make.unique(paste(gene,display_variant,sep=" ")))

comparison_prefilter_samples <- multicaller_prefilter_support %>%
  distinct(sample,sample_label,patient,endpoint) %>%
  left_join(
    multicaller_prefilter_support %>%
      left_join(comparison_prefilter_mutations %>% select(mutation_id,mutation_rank),by="mutation_id") %>%
      group_by(sample) %>%
      summarise(first_mutation=min(mutation_rank),.groups="drop"),
    by="sample") %>%
  mutate(endpoint=factor(endpoint,levels=c("BL","END")),patient_num=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(patient))) %>%
  arrange(first_mutation,is.na(patient_num),patient_num,patient,endpoint,sample) %>%
  mutate(plot_sample=make.unique(sample_label))

#Keep the prefilter order in the retained panel
comparison_postfilter_mutations <- comparison_prefilter_mutations %>%
  semi_join(multicaller_postfilter_support %>% distinct(mutation_id),by="mutation_id")
comparison_postfilter_samples <- comparison_prefilter_samples %>%
  semi_join(multicaller_postfilter_support %>% distinct(sample),by="sample")

make_multicaller_matrix <- function(records,mutation_info,sample_info) {
  plot_cells <- records %>%
    left_join(mutation_info %>% select(mutation_id,plot_label),by="mutation_id") %>%
    left_join(sample_info %>% select(sample,plot_sample),by="sample") %>%
    filter(!is.na(plot_label),!is.na(plot_sample)) %>%
    group_by(plot_label,plot_sample) %>%
    summarise(
      callers=paste(comparison_caller_order[comparison_caller_order%in%unique(caller)],collapse=";"),
      .groups="drop")

  plot_matrix <- matrix(
    "",
    nrow=nrow(mutation_info),
    ncol=nrow(sample_info),
    dimnames=list(mutation_info$plot_label,sample_info$plot_sample))
  plot_index <- plot_cells %>%
    transmute(
      row=match(plot_label,rownames(plot_matrix)),
      column=match(plot_sample,colnames(plot_matrix)),
      callers=callers) %>%
    filter(!is.na(row),!is.na(column))
  plot_matrix[cbind(plot_index$row,plot_index$column)] <- plot_index$callers
  plot_matrix
}

multicaller_prefilter_matrix <- make_multicaller_matrix(
  multicaller_prefilter_records,
  comparison_prefilter_mutations,
  comparison_prefilter_samples)
multicaller_postfilter_matrix <- make_multicaller_matrix(
  multicaller_postfilter_records,
  comparison_postfilter_mutations,
  comparison_postfilter_samples)

stopifnot(sum(nzchar(multicaller_prefilter_matrix))==110L,sum(nzchar(multicaller_postfilter_matrix))==31L)

n_comparison_callers <- length(comparison_caller_order)
comparison_alter_fun <- c(
  list(
    background=function(x,y,w,h) {
      grid.rect(x,y,w*.96,h*.92,gp=gpar(fill="#F3F3F3",col="white",lwd=.5))
    }),
  setNames(
    lapply(seq_along(comparison_caller_order),function(k) {
      caller_colour <- unname(comparison_caller_colours[comparison_caller_order[k]])
      force(k)
      force(caller_colour)
      function(x,y,w,h) {
        grid.rect(
          x,
          y-h/2+(k-.5)*h/n_comparison_callers,
          w*.90,
          h/n_comparison_callers*.82,
          gp=gpar(fill=caller_colour,col=NA))
      }
    }),
    comparison_caller_order))

make_multicaller_heatmap <- function(
  plot_matrix,mutation_info,show_legend,row_font,column_font,
  heatmap_height_mm) {
  ComplexHeatmap::oncoPrint(
    plot_matrix,
    get_type=function(x) {
      if(is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) {
        character(0)
      } else {
        strsplit(x,";",fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
      }
    },
    alter_fun=comparison_alter_fun,
    col=comparison_caller_colours,
    alter_fun_is_vectorized=FALSE,
    row_split=factor(mutation_info$gene,levels=unique(comparison_prefilter_mutations$gene)),
    row_gap=unit(1.2,"mm"),
    column_order=seq_len(ncol(plot_matrix)),
    remove_empty_rows=FALSE,
    remove_empty_columns=FALSE,
    show_pct=FALSE,
    show_row_names=TRUE,
    row_names_gp=gpar(fontsize=row_font),
    show_column_names=TRUE,
    column_names_rot=90,
    column_names_gp=gpar(fontsize=column_font),
    row_names_max_width=unit(62,"mm"),
    height=unit(heatmap_height_mm,"mm"),
    row_title="Variant",
    show_heatmap_legend=show_legend,
    heatmap_legend_param=list(
      title="Variant caller",
      at=comparison_caller_order,
      labels=comparison_caller_order,
      ncol=1))
}

  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,100),breaks=seq(0,100,20),expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.12))) +
  labs(
    title="C  Caller support before and after filtering",
    subtitle="Percentages use pre-filter n=110 and final retained n=31",
    x="Number of supporting callers",
    y="Candidates (%)",
    fill=NULL) +
  theme_unified(base_size=10) +
  theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold"),legend.position="bottom",axis.text.x=element_text(face="bold"))

make_comparison_title <- function(label) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text",x=0,y=.5,label=label,hjust=0,vjust=.5,size=4,fontface="bold") +
    xlim(0,1) +
    ylim(0,1) +
    theme_void(base_size=10,base_family="sans") +
    theme(plot.margin=margin(0,0,0,0))
}

multicaller_prefilter_title <- make_comparison_title("A  Pre-filter positive candidates (n=110)")
multicaller_postfilter_title <- make_comparison_title("B  Final retained positive calls (n=31)")

multicaller_filter_comparison_panel <- patchwork::wrap_plots(

if(!requireNamespace("patchwork",quietly=TRUE)) {

figure2_workflow_edges <- tibble(

p_figure2_workflow <- ggplot() +

#Panel B: input observations by caller
figure2_input_callers <- caller_contribution_counts %>%
  transmute(caller=recode(caller,"Pisces NL40"="Pisces","VarScan"="VarScan2"),observations=records,percentage=share) %>%

figure2_caller_colours <- c(

#Panel C: single-caller and multicaller support
figure2_support_shift <- bind_rows(
  candidate_support_verified %>%

#Panel D: final inclusive caller support
figure2_final_support <- caller_contribution_summary %>%

p_figure2_final_support <- ggplot(figure2_final_support,aes(calls,caller,fill=support_class)) +

# 3 ctDNA detectability and molecular VAF

## 3.1 Variant detectability

```{r variant-detectability}
#Sample availability
sample_availability <- samples %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END")) %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint) %>%
  mutate(available="Yes") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=endpoint,values_from=available,names_prefix="available_",values_fill="No")

#Final variant calls
detectability_calls <- final_variants %>%
  mutate(
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(endpoint),
    n_callers=as.numeric(n_callers),

    mutation=case_when(
      !is.na(hgvsp) & hgvsp!="" & hgvsp!="." ~
        str_replace(hgvsp,"^.*:",""),

      !is.na(hgvsc) & hgvsc!="" & hgvsc!="." ~
        str_replace(hgvsc,"^.*:",""),

      TRUE ~ variant_id),

    detected="Yes") %>%

  select(patient,gene,mutation,variant_id,endpoint,detected,n_callers,callers_detected) %>%

  distinct()

#Place timepoints side by side
variant_BL_END <- detectability_calls %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from=endpoint,

    values_from=c(detected,n_callers,callers_detected),

    names_glue="{endpoint}_{.value}",

    values_fill=list(
      detected="No",
      n_callers=0,
      callers_detected="-")) %>%

  left_join(sample_availability,by="patient") %>%

  mutate(
    BL=case_when(BL_detected=="Yes" ~ "Yes",available_BL=="Yes" ~ "No",TRUE ~ "Not available"),

    END=case_when(END_detected=="Yes" ~ "Yes",available_END=="Yes" ~ "No",TRUE ~ "Not available"),

    status=case_when(
      BL=="Yes" & END=="Yes" ~ "BL + END",
      BL=="Yes" ~ "BL only",
      END=="Yes" ~ "END only",
      BL=="Not available" |
        END=="Not available" ~ "One timepoint unavailable",
      TRUE ~ "Not detected")) %>%

  transmute(
    patient,
    gene,
    mutation,
    genomic_id=variant_id,
    status,

    BL,
    BL_n_callers,
    BL_callers=BL_callers_detected,

    END,
    END_n_callers,
    END_callers=END_callers_detected) %>%

  arrange(patient,gene,mutation)

variant_BL_END
```

### 3.1.1 Variants found at both timepoints

```{r persistent-bl-end-variants, echo=FALSE}
persistent_bl_end_variants <- variant_BL_END %>%
  filter(status=="BL + END") %>%
  select(patient,gene,mutation,genomic_id,BL_callers,END_callers) %>%
  arrange(patient,gene,mutation)

n_persistent_patients <- n_distinct(persistent_bl_end_variants$patient)
n_persistent_variants <- nrow(persistent_bl_end_variants)

persistent_bl_end_gt <- persistent_bl_end_variants %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    patient="Patient",

    mutation="Mutation",

    END_callers="Post-RT caller(s)") %>%
  cols_align("left",columns=everything()) %>%
  cols_width(patient~px(65),gene~px(65),mutation~px(95),genomic_id~px(125),BL_callers~px(85),END_callers~px(85)) %>%
  tab_source_note(md(paste0(
    "*",n_persistent_variants," variants in ",
    n_persistent_patients,
    " patients were retained at both BL and post-radiotherapy.*"))) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.names="Arial",
    table.font.size=10,
    table.width=px(520),
    table.layout="fixed",
    table.align="left",
    data_row.padding=1,
    column_labels.padding=2,
    source_notes.font.size=8)

persistent_bl_end_gt
```

### 3.1.2 Detectability table

```{r publication-detectability}
sample_denominators <- samples %>%
  mutate(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(endpoint),sample_id=as.character(sample)) %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END")) %>%
  summarise(BL_patients=n_distinct(patient[endpoint=="BL"]),
            END_patients=n_distinct(patient[endpoint=="END"]),
            BL_samples=n_distinct(sample_id[endpoint=="BL"]),
            END_samples=n_distinct(sample_id[endpoint=="END"]))

summary_calls <- final_variants %>%
  transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(endpoint),gene,variant_id) %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END")) %>% distinct() %>%
  left_join(samples %>%
              transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(endpoint),
                        sample_id=as.character(sample)) %>% distinct(),
            by=c("patient","endpoint"))

summarise_detectability <- function(x,gene_name){
  tibble(gene=gene_name,
         BL_patients=n_distinct(x$patient[x$endpoint=="BL"]),
         END_patients=n_distinct(x$patient[x$endpoint=="END"]),
         BL_samples=n_distinct(x$sample_id[x$endpoint=="BL"],na.rm=TRUE),
         END_samples=n_distinct(x$sample_id[x$endpoint=="END"],na.rm=TRUE),
         total_patients=n_distinct(x$patient),unique_variants=n_distinct(x$variant_id),
         variant_calls=n_distinct(paste(x$patient,x$endpoint,x$variant_id)))
}

detectability_table <- bind_rows(
  summarise_detectability(summary_calls,"Any variant"),
  map_dfr(sort(unique(summary_calls$gene)),
          ~summarise_detectability(filter(summary_calls,gene==.x),.x))) %>%
  mutate(
    `Baseline patients`=sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)",BL_patients,sample_denominators$BL_patients,
                                100*BL_patients/sample_denominators$BL_patients),
    `Post-radiotherapy patients`=sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)",END_patients,sample_denominators$END_patients,
                                         100*END_patients/sample_denominators$END_patients),
    `Baseline samples`=sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)",BL_samples,sample_denominators$BL_samples,
                               100*BL_samples/sample_denominators$BL_samples),
    `Post-radiotherapy samples`=sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)",END_samples,sample_denominators$END_samples,
                                        100*END_samples/sample_denominators$END_samples)) %>%
  select(gene,`Baseline patients`,`Post-radiotherapy patients`,`Baseline samples`,
         `Post-radiotherapy samples`,total_patients,unique_variants,variant_calls)

detectability_gt <- detectability_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    gene="Gene",
    total_patients="Patients overall",unique_variants="Unique variants",
    variant_calls="Variant calls") %>%
  tab_header(
    title=md("**Plasma ctDNA detectability**"),
    subtitle="Detectability by gene at the patient and plasma-sample levels, n/N (%)") %>%
  cols_align(align="left",columns=gene) %>%
  cols_align(align="center",columns=-gene) %>%
  tab_style(style=cell_text(weight="bold"),locations=cells_column_labels()) %>%
  tab_style(style=cell_text(weight="bold"),locations=cells_body(rows=gene=="Any variant")) %>%
  tab_style(style=cell_text(style="italic"),locations=cells_body(columns=gene,rows=gene!="Any variant")) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note=md("*Detectability values are n/N (%). Variant calls are distinct patient-endpoint-variant combinations.*")) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.names="Arial",
    table.font.size=10,
    heading.align="left",
    data_row.padding=4,
    column_labels.padding=6,
    row.striping.background_color="white",
    table.border.top.color="black",
    table.border.bottom.color="black",
    column_labels.border.top.color="black",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color="black")

detectability_gt
```

## 3.2 Maximum molecular VAF

```{r max-vaf-calculations}
if(!exists("final_variants")) stop("Run the final adjudication section first.")

#One row per retained variant
vaf_values <- final_variants %>%
  transmute(
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)),
    gene=as.character(gene),
    variant_id=as.character(variant_id),
    molecular_vaf_percent=as.numeric(molecular_vaf_percent)) %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END"),!is.na(molecular_vaf_percent)) %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,.keep_all=TRUE)

#Maximum VAF per positive patient and timepoint
sample_max_vaf <- vaf_values %>%
  group_by(patient,endpoint) %>%
  summarise(n_variants=n(),max_vaf=max(molecular_vaf_percent),.groups="drop") %>%
  arrange(endpoint,patient)

#Values used in the summary
print(vaf_values %>% arrange(endpoint,patient,gene),n=Inf)
print(sample_max_vaf,n=Inf)

#Summarise positive samples
max_vaf_summary <- sample_max_vaf %>%
  group_by(endpoint) %>%
  summarise(
    positive_samples=n(),
    positive_patients=n_distinct(patient),
    retained_variants=sum(n_variants),
    median_max_vaf=median(max_vaf),
    q1_max_vaf=quantile(max_vaf,.25),
    q3_max_vaf=quantile(max_vaf,.75),
    .groups="drop")

print(max_vaf_summary)
```

## 3.3 Baseline and post-radiotherapy maximum VAF

```{r pooled-max-vaf, echo=FALSE, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=5.5, out.width='60%'}
#Patients with both timepoints
paired_samples <- samples %>%
  transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint))) %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END")) %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint) %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(endpoint)==2) %>%
  ungroup()

#Join maximum VAF to paired samples
#Missing calls remain undetected, not zero
paired_max_vaf <- paired_samples %>%
  left_join(sample_max_vaf,by=c("patient","endpoint")) %>%
  mutate(detected=!is.na(max_vaf),n_variants=replace_na(n_variants,0L))

print(paired_max_vaf %>% arrange(patient,endpoint),n=Inf)

#Detection uses all pairs; VAF uses positive samples
pooled_max_vaf_summary <- paired_max_vaf %>%
  group_by(endpoint) %>%
  summarise(
    paired_samples=n(),
    detected_samples=sum(detected),
    not_detected_samples=sum(!detected),
    detection_percent=100*detected_samples/paired_samples,
    median_max_vaf=if(any(detected)) median(max_vaf[detected]) else NA_real_,
    q1_max_vaf=if(any(detected)) quantile(max_vaf[detected],.25) else NA_real_,
    q3_max_vaf=if(any(detected)) quantile(max_vaf[detected],.75) else NA_real_,
    .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint=recode(endpoint,BL="Baseline",END="Post-radiotherapy"),
    timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=names(timepoint_colours)))

print(pooled_max_vaf_summary)

#Exploratory unpaired comparison
max_vaf_unpaired_data <- paired_max_vaf %>%
  filter(detected) %>%
  select(patient,endpoint,max_vaf)

max_vaf_unpaired_test <- wilcox.test(
  x=max_vaf_unpaired_data$max_vaf[max_vaf_unpaired_data$endpoint=="BL"],
  y=max_vaf_unpaired_data$max_vaf[max_vaf_unpaired_data$endpoint=="END"],
  paired=FALSE,
  exact=FALSE,
  correct=TRUE)

max_vaf_unpaired_p <- max_vaf_unpaired_test$p.value

#Exact paired detection test
paired_detection_status <- paired_max_vaf %>%
  select(patient,endpoint,detected) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=endpoint,values_from=detected)

stopifnot(all(c("BL","END")%in%names(paired_detection_status)))

n_both_detected <- sum(paired_detection_status$BL & paired_detection_status$END)
n_bl_only <- sum(paired_detection_status$BL & !paired_detection_status$END)
n_end_only <- sum(!paired_detection_status$BL & paired_detection_status$END)
n_neither_detected <- sum(!paired_detection_status$BL & !paired_detection_status$END)
n_detection_discordant <- n_bl_only+n_end_only

detection_p_value <- if(n_detection_discordant>0) {
  binom.test(n_end_only,n_detection_discordant,p=.5,alternative="two.sided")$p.value
} else {
  1
}

#Complete positive pairs
paired_positive_vaf_wide <- paired_max_vaf %>%
  filter(detected) %>%
  select(patient,endpoint,max_vaf) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=endpoint,values_from=max_vaf) %>%
  filter(!is.na(BL),!is.na(END)) %>%
  mutate(change=END-BL)

format_test_p <- function(x) {
  if(is.na(x)) {
    "not estimable"
  } else if(x<.001) {
    "<0.001"
  } else {
    formatC(x,format="f",digits=3)
  }
}

paired_test_summary <- tibble(
  comparison="Detection status: baseline versus post-radiotherapy",
  population=paste0(nrow(paired_detection_status)," paired patients"),
  test="Exact paired McNemar",
  p_value=detection_p_value)

max_vaf_unpaired_test_summary <- tibble(
  comparison="Maximum molecular VAF: baseline versus post-radiotherapy",
  population=paste0(
    "Baseline n=",sum(max_vaf_unpaired_data$endpoint=="BL"),
    "; post-radiotherapy n=",sum(max_vaf_unpaired_data$endpoint=="END"),
    "; ",nrow(paired_positive_vaf_wide),
    " patients contribute to both groups"),
  test="Exploratory Wilcoxon rank-sum",
  p_value=max_vaf_unpaired_p)

print(paired_detection_status,n=Inf)
print(paired_positive_vaf_wide,n=Inf)
print(paired_test_summary)
print(max_vaf_unpaired_test_summary)
message("Exploratory maxVAF Wilcoxon rank-sum P=",format_test_p(max_vaf_unpaired_p))

#Paired-cohort summary
pooled_max_vaf_stats_display <- pooled_max_vaf_summary %>%
  transmute(
    timepoint=as.character(timepoint),
    paired_samples,
    detected=sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)",detected_samples,detection_percent),
    not_detected=sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)",not_detected_samples,100-detection_percent),
    median_iqr=paste0(
      formatC(median_max_vaf,format="fg",digits=3),
      " (",
      formatC(q1_max_vaf,format="fg",digits=3),
      "-",
      formatC(q3_max_vaf,format="fg",digits=3),
      ")"))

pooled_max_vaf_stats_gt <- pooled_max_vaf_stats_display %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    timepoint="Timepoint",
    paired_samples="Paired samples",
    detected="Detected, n (%)",
    not_detected="Not detected, n (%)",
    median_iqr=md("Median maximum VAF<br>(IQR), %")) %>%
  cols_align("left",columns=timepoint) %>%
  cols_align("center",columns=-timepoint) %>%
  cols_width(timepoint~px(120),paired_samples~px(70),detected~px(90),not_detected~px(95),median_iqr~px(120)) %>%
  tab_source_note(md(paste0(
    "*Maximum molecular VAF excludes non-detected samples. Exploratory Wilcoxon rank-sum P=",
    format_test_p(max_vaf_unpaired_p),
    "; three patients contribute to both groups, so independence is incomplete. Exact paired detection P=",
    format_test_p(detection_p_value),
    ". No paired VAF test was performed because only ",
    nrow(paired_positive_vaf_wide),
    " patients were positive at both endpoints.*"))) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.names="Arial",
    table.font.size=10,
    table.width=px(490),
    table.layout="fixed",
    table.align="left",
    data_row.padding=1,
    column_labels.padding=2,
    source_notes.font.size=8)

pooled_max_vaf_stats_gt

#Plot VAF for detected samples only
max_vaf_plot_data <- paired_max_vaf %>%
  filter(detected) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint=recode(endpoint,BL="Baseline",END="Post-radiotherapy"),
    timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=names(timepoint_colours)))

max_vaf_bracket_y <- max(max_vaf_plot_data$max_vaf,na.rm=TRUE)*1.35
max_vaf_bracket_tick_y <- max(max_vaf_plot_data$max_vaf,na.rm=TRUE)*1.20
max_vaf_label_y <- max(max_vaf_plot_data$max_vaf,na.rm=TRUE)*1.60

p_max_vaf <- ggplot(max_vaf_plot_data,aes(timepoint,max_vaf,fill=timepoint)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=.48,alpha=.6,outlier.shape=NA,colour="black",linewidth=.55) +

## 3.4 Gene-level detectability and maximum VAF

```{r gene-detectability-max-vaf, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8.2, fig.height=8.5, out.width='75%'}
if(!requireNamespace("patchwork",quietly=TRUE)) {
  stop("Install patchwork first: install.packages('patchwork')")
}

genes_report <- c("GNAQ","GNA11","BAP1","SF3B1","EIF1AX")

#All patients and timepoints
sample_endpoints <- samples %>%
  transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint))) %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END")) %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint)

#Maximum VAF per patient, timepoint and gene
gene_sample_vaf <- final_variants %>%
  transmute(
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)),
    gene=as.character(gene),
    variant_id=as.character(variant_id),
    molecular_vaf_percent=as.numeric(molecular_vaf_percent)) %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END"),gene%in%genes_report,!is.na(molecular_vaf_percent)) %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,.keep_all=TRUE) %>%
  group_by(patient,endpoint,gene) %>%
  summarise(n_variants=n(),max_vaf=max(molecular_vaf_percent),.groups="drop")

#Add undetected patient-gene combinations
gene_detectability <- tidyr::crossing(sample_endpoints,gene=genes_report) %>%
  left_join(gene_sample_vaf,by=c("patient","endpoint","gene")) %>%
  mutate(
    detected=!is.na(max_vaf),
    n_variants=replace_na(n_variants,0L),
    timepoint=recode(endpoint,BL="Baseline",END="Post-radiotherapy"),
    timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=c("Baseline","Post-radiotherapy")),
    gene=factor(gene,levels=genes_report))

#Detectability by gene and timepoint
gene_detection_summary <- gene_detectability %>%
  group_by(timepoint,gene) %>%
  summarise(n_total=n(),n_detected=sum(detected),percent=100*n_detected/n_total,.groups="drop")

#VAF summary among detected samples
gene_max_vaf_summary <- gene_detectability %>%
  filter(detected) %>%
  group_by(timepoint,gene) %>%
  summarise(
    detected_samples=n(),
    median_of_sample_maxima=median(max_vaf),
    q1_sample_max_vaf=quantile(max_vaf,.25),
    q3_sample_max_vaf=quantile(max_vaf,.75),
    .groups="drop")

print(gene_detection_summary,n=Inf)
print(gene_sample_vaf %>% arrange(endpoint,gene,patient),n=Inf)
print(gene_max_vaf_summary,n=Inf)

#Panel A: detectability
detection_dodge <- position_dodge(width=.78)

p_gene_detection <- ggplot(gene_detection_summary,aes(gene,percent,fill=timepoint)) +
  geom_col(position=detection_dodge,width=.68,colour="black",linewidth=.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0(n_detected,"/",n_total)),position=detection_dodge,vjust=-.4,size=3.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=timepoint_colours,drop=FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.16)),breaks=seq(0,100,20)) +
  labs(
    title=NULL,
    x=NULL,
    y="ctDNA-positive patients (%)",
    subtitle="Grouped baseline and post-radiotherapy detection",
    fill=NULL) +
  theme_unified(base_size=10) +
  theme(legend.position="bottom",axis.text.x=element_text(face="italic"))

#Panel B: median maximum VAF
vaf_dodge <- position_dodge(width=.78)

p_gene_max_vaf <- ggplot(gene_max_vaf_summary,aes(gene,median_of_sample_maxima,fill=timepoint)) +
  geom_col(position=vaf_dodge,width=.68,colour="black",linewidth=.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=q1_sample_max_vaf,ymax=q3_sample_max_vaf),position=vaf_dodge,width=.18,linewidth=.45) +
  geom_text(aes(y=q3_sample_max_vaf,label=paste0("n=",detected_samples)),position=vaf_dodge,vjust=-.45,size=3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=timepoint_colours,drop=FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::label_number(accuracy=.01),expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.18))) +
  labs(
    title=NULL,
    x=NULL,
    y="Median maximum molecular VAF (%)",
    subtitle="Bars show median maxVAF; whiskers show IQR",
    fill=NULL) +
  theme_unified(base_size=10) +
  theme(legend.position="bottom",axis.text.x=element_text(face="italic"))

figure3_4 <- patchwork::wrap_plots(p_gene_detection,p_gene_max_vaf,ncol=1,heights=c(1,1.15),guides="collect") +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels="A",theme=figure_tag_theme) &
  theme(legend.position="bottom")

#Save the figure
print(figure3_4)

figure_path <- file.path(path,"figures")
dir.create(figure_path,showWarnings=FALSE)
ggsave(
  file.path(figure_path,"Supplementary_Figure_S10_gene_detectability_maxVAF.png"),
  figure3_4,width=8.2,height=8.5,dpi=publication_dpi,bg="white")

### 3.4.1 Gene-level summary table

```{r gene-level-publication-table, echo=FALSE}
gene_table_order <- c("All genes","GNAQ","GNA11","BAP1","SF3B1","EIF1AX")
gene_table_genes <- setdiff(gene_table_order,"All genes")

#Use patients with both timepoints
gene_table_endpoints <- samples %>%
  transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint))) %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END")) %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint) %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(endpoint)==2L) %>%
  ungroup()

gene_table_denominators <- gene_table_endpoints %>%
  count(endpoint,name="denominator")

stopifnot(n_distinct(gene_table_endpoints$patient)==52L,all(gene_table_denominators$denominator==52L))

gene_table_calls <- final_variants %>%
  transmute(
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)),
    gene=as.character(gene),
    variant_id=as.character(variant_id),
    molecular_vaf_percent=as.numeric(molecular_vaf_percent)) %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END"),gene%in%gene_table_genes) %>%
  semi_join(gene_table_endpoints,by=c("patient","endpoint")) %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,gene,variant_id,.keep_all=TRUE)

gene_table_gene_counts <- gene_table_calls %>%
  group_by(gene,endpoint) %>%
  summarise(
    positive_patients=n_distinct(patient),
    variant_calls=n(),
    unique_variants=n_distinct(variant_id),
    .groups="drop")

gene_table_overall_counts <- gene_table_calls %>%
  group_by(endpoint) %>%
  summarise(
    gene="All genes",
    positive_patients=n_distinct(patient),
    variant_calls=n(),
    unique_variants=n_distinct(variant_id),
    .groups="drop")

#Summarise maximum VAF across patients
gene_table_gene_patient_vaf <- gene_table_calls %>%
  filter(!is.na(molecular_vaf_percent)) %>%
  group_by(patient,endpoint,gene) %>%
  summarise(patient_max_vaf=max(molecular_vaf_percent),.groups="drop")

gene_table_overall_patient_vaf <- gene_table_calls %>%
  filter(!is.na(molecular_vaf_percent)) %>%
  group_by(patient,endpoint) %>%
  summarise(gene="All genes",patient_max_vaf=max(molecular_vaf_percent),.groups="drop")

gene_table_vaf_summary <- bind_rows(gene_table_gene_patient_vaf,gene_table_overall_patient_vaf) %>%
  group_by(gene,endpoint) %>%
  summarise(
    vaf_patients=n(),
    median_vaf=median(patient_max_vaf),
    q1_vaf=quantile(patient_max_vaf,.25),
    q3_vaf=quantile(patient_max_vaf,.75),
    .groups="drop")

gene_distribution_endpoint_summary <- tidyr::crossing(gene=gene_table_order,endpoint=c("BL","END")) %>%
  left_join(bind_rows(gene_table_gene_counts,gene_table_overall_counts),by=c("gene","endpoint")) %>%
  left_join(gene_table_vaf_summary,by=c("gene","endpoint")) %>%
  left_join(gene_table_denominators,by="endpoint") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(positive_patients,variant_calls,unique_variants,vaf_patients),~replace_na(.x,0L)),
    detection_percent=100*positive_patients/denominator,
    detectability=sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)",positive_patients,denominator,detection_percent),
    median_iqr_vaf=case_when(
      vaf_patients==0L ~ "Not detected",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",median_vaf,q1_vaf,q3_vaf)))

gene_distribution_publication <- gene_distribution_endpoint_summary %>%
  select(
    gene,endpoint,positive_patients,detection_percent,detectability,
    variant_calls,unique_variants,median_iqr_vaf) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from=endpoint,
    values_from=c(positive_patients,detection_percent,detectability,variant_calls,unique_variants,median_iqr_vaf),
    names_glue="{.value}_{endpoint}") %>%
  mutate(
    gene_class=case_when(
      gene=="All genes" ~ "Overall",
      gene%in%c("GNAQ","GNA11") ~ "Driver genes",
      TRUE ~ "Prognostic genes"),
    detectability_change_pp=detection_percent_END-detection_percent_BL,
    change=sprintf("%+.1f",detectability_change_pp),
    variant_calls_bl_post=paste(variant_calls_BL,variant_calls_END,sep=" / "),
    unique_variants_bl_post=paste(unique_variants_BL,unique_variants_END,sep=" / "),
    gene=factor(gene,levels=gene_table_order),
    gene_class=factor(
      gene_class,
      levels=c("Overall","Driver genes","Prognostic genes"))) %>%
  arrange(gene) %>%
  transmute(
    gene_class,
    gene,
    baseline_detectability=detectability_BL,
    post_detectability=detectability_END,
    change,
    variant_calls_bl_post,
    unique_variants_bl_post,
    baseline_vaf=median_iqr_vaf_BL,
    post_vaf=median_iqr_vaf_END)

#Paired tests
gene_table_detection_pairs <- gene_table_endpoints %>%
  left_join(gene_table_calls %>% distinct(patient,endpoint) %>% mutate(detected=TRUE),by=c("patient","endpoint")) %>%
  mutate(detected=replace_na(detected,FALSE)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=endpoint,values_from=detected)

gene_table_gained <- sum(!gene_table_detection_pairs$BL & gene_table_detection_pairs$END)
gene_table_lost <- sum(gene_table_detection_pairs$BL & !gene_table_detection_pairs$END)
gene_table_discordant <- gene_table_gained+gene_table_lost
gene_table_detection_p <- if(gene_table_discordant>0L) {
  binom.test(gene_table_gained,gene_table_discordant,p=.5,alternative="two.sided")$p.value
} else {
  1
}

gene_table_paired_vaf <- gene_table_overall_patient_vaf %>%
  select(patient,endpoint,patient_max_vaf) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=endpoint,values_from=patient_max_vaf) %>%
  drop_na(BL,END)

stopifnot(
  gene_distribution_endpoint_summary %>%
    filter(gene=="All genes",endpoint=="BL") %>%
    pull(positive_patients)==7L,
  gene_distribution_endpoint_summary %>%
    filter(gene=="All genes",endpoint=="END") %>%
    pull(positive_patients)==17L,
  gene_table_gained==14L,
  gene_table_lost==4L)

#Build the manuscript table
gene_distribution_publication_gt <- gene_distribution_publication %>%
  gt(groupname_col="gene_class") %>%
  cols_label(
    gene="Gene",
    baseline_detectability="Baseline",
    post_detectability="Post-RT",
    change=md("Change<br>(pp)"),
    variant_calls_bl_post=md("Variant calls<br>BL / post"),
    unique_variants_bl_post=md("Unique variants<br>BL / post"),
    baseline_vaf="Baseline",
    post_vaf="Post-RT") %>%
  tab_spanner(label="Positive patients, n/N (%)",columns=c(baseline_detectability,post_detectability,change)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label="Variant distribution",columns=c(variant_calls_bl_post,unique_variants_bl_post)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label=md("Median maximum VAF (IQR), %"),columns=c(baseline_vaf,post_vaf)) %>%
  cols_align("left",columns=gene) %>%
  cols_align("center",columns=-gene) %>%
  cols_width(
    gene~px(65),
    baseline_detectability~px(105),
    post_detectability~px(105),
    change~px(55),
    variant_calls_bl_post~px(80),
    unique_variants_bl_post~px(85),
    baseline_vaf~px(125),
    post_vaf~px(125)) %>%
  tab_style(style=cell_text(weight="bold"),locations=cells_column_labels()) %>%
  tab_style(style=cell_text(weight="bold"),locations=cells_row_groups()) %>%
  tab_style(style=cell_text(style="italic"),locations=cells_body(columns=gene,rows=gene!="All genes")) %>%
  tab_source_note(md(paste0(
    "*Detectability uses 52 paired patients at each endpoint. Maximum molecular VAF is summarized across positive patients only; exploratory Wilcoxon rank-sum P=",
    format_test_p(max_vaf_unpaired_p),
    ". Three patients contribute to both VAF groups, so independence is incomplete. Overall exact paired McNemar P=",
    format.pval(gene_table_detection_p,digits=3),
    " (14 gained and 4 lost detection). No paired VAF test was performed because only ",
    nrow(gene_table_paired_vaf),
    " patients were positive at both endpoints.*"))) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.names="Arial",
    table.font.size=10,
    table.align="left",
    table.width=px(745),
    table.layout="fixed",
    data_row.padding=2,
    column_labels.padding=3,
    row_group.padding=3,
    source_notes.font.size=8,
    source_notes.padding=2,
    table.border.top.color="black",
    table.border.bottom.color="black",
    column_labels.border.top.color="black",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color="black",
    row.striping.background_color="white")

gene_distribution_publication_gt

gene_table_output_dir <- file.path(path,"publication_tables")
dir.create(gene_table_output_dir,showWarnings=FALSE)
gtsave(
  gene_distribution_publication_gt,
  file.path(gene_table_output_dir,"gene_level_variant_distribution_detectability_vaf.png"),
  zoom=2,
  expand=10)
gtsave(
  gene_distribution_publication_gt,
  file.path(
    gene_table_output_dir,
    "gene_level_variant_distribution_detectability_vaf.rtf"))

## 3.5 OncoPrint and detectability panels

```{r ctdna-detectability-panels, include=FALSE}
if(!requireNamespace("patchwork",quietly=TRUE)) {
  stop("Install patchwork first: install.packages('patchwork')")
}

detect_genes <- c("GNAQ","GNA11","BAP1","SF3B1","EIF1AX")
detect_colours <- timepoint_colours

#Patients with both timepoints
detect_endpoints <- samples %>%
  transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint))) %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END")) %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint) %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(endpoint)==2L) %>%
  ungroup()

#Detection status by patient and timepoint
detect_sample_status <- detect_endpoints %>%
  left_join(
    final_variants %>%
      transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint))) %>%
      filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END")) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      mutate(detected=TRUE),
    by=c("patient","endpoint")) %>%
  mutate(detected=replace_na(detected,FALSE))

detect_wide <- detect_sample_status %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=endpoint,values_from=detected)

detect_gained <- sum(!detect_wide$BL & detect_wide$END)
detect_lost <- sum(detect_wide$BL & !detect_wide$END)
detect_discordant <- detect_gained+detect_lost
detect_p <- binom.test(detect_gained,detect_discordant,p=.5,alternative="two.sided")$p.value

detect_overall <- detect_sample_status %>%
  group_by(endpoint) %>%
  summarise(denominator=n(),positive=sum(detected),percent=100*positive/denominator,.groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint=recode(endpoint,BL="Baseline",END="Post-radiotherapy"),
    timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=names(detect_colours)),
    label=sprintf("%.1f%%\n(%d/%d)",percent,positive,denominator))

#Complete patient, timepoint and gene grid
detect_gene_status <- tidyr::crossing(
  patient=sort(unique(detect_endpoints$patient)),
  endpoint=c("BL","END"),
  gene=detect_genes) %>%
  left_join(
    final_variants %>%
      transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)),gene=as.character(gene)) %>%
      filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END"),gene%in%detect_genes) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      mutate(detected=TRUE),
    by=c("patient","endpoint","gene")) %>%
  mutate(detected=replace_na(detected,FALSE))

detect_by_gene <- detect_gene_status %>%
  group_by(gene,endpoint) %>%
  summarise(denominator=n(),positive=sum(detected),percent=100*positive/denominator,.groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(
    gene=factor(gene,levels=detect_genes),
    gene_class=if_else(as.character(gene)%in%c("GNAQ","GNA11"),"Driver genes","Prognostic genes"),
    gene_class=factor(gene_class,levels=c("Driver genes","Prognostic genes")),
    timepoint=recode(endpoint,BL="Baseline",END="Post-radiotherapy"),
    timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=names(detect_colours)),
    label=sprintf("%.1f%%",percent))

stopifnot(
  n_distinct(detect_endpoints$patient)==52L,
  detect_overall$positive[detect_overall$endpoint=="BL"]==7L,
  detect_overall$positive[detect_overall$endpoint=="END"]==17L,
  detect_gained==14L,
  detect_lost==4L)

detect_theme <- theme_unified(base_size=10) +
  theme(
    plot.title=element_text(face="bold",size=11),
    axis.text.x=element_text(size=9),
    axis.title=element_text(face="plain"),
    legend.position="bottom",
    legend.title=element_blank())

p_detect_overall <- ggplot(detect_overall,aes(timepoint,percent,fill=timepoint)) +
  geom_col(width=.58,colour="black",linewidth=.35) +
  geom_text(aes(label=label),vjust=-.35,size=4,lineheight=.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=detect_colours,drop=FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,43),breaks=seq(0,40,10),expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.02))) +
  labs(x=NULL,y="Positive patients (%)",title=NULL,subtitle=NULL) +
  guides(fill="none") +
  detect_theme

p_detect_gene <- ggplot(detect_by_gene,aes(gene,percent,fill=timepoint)) +
  geom_col(position=position_dodge(width=.78),width=.70,colour="black",linewidth=.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label=label),position=position_dodge(width=.78),vjust=-.35,size=3.5) +
  facet_grid(cols=vars(gene_class),scales="free_x",space="free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=detect_colours,drop=FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,22),breaks=seq(0,20,5),expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.02))) +
  labs(x=NULL,y="Positive patients (%)",title=NULL,subtitle=NULL) +
  detect_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x=element_text(face="italic",size=9),
    strip.background=element_blank(),
    strip.text=element_text(face="bold",size=9),
    panel.spacing.x=unit(5,"mm"))

#Objects used in the main figure
```

### 3.5.1 Main ctDNA figure

```{r main-ctdna-detectability-figure, echo=FALSE, fig.width=13, fig.height=7.5, out.width='100%', fig.keep='last'}
  timepoint_colours <- unified_colours[c("Baseline","Post-radiotherapy")]

  mutation_colours <- c(
    "Missense"   = "#D4A017",
    "Frameshift" = "#B2182B",
    "Stop gained" = "#E66101",
    "Splice"     = "#2166AC",
    "Deletion"   = "#6F5A7E",
    "Insertion"  = "#D27D5A",
    "Other coding" = "#7F7F7F")

  #Select retained variants
  plot_variants <- final_variants %>%
    mutate(patient = as.character(patient),endpoint = toupper(as.character(endpoint)),gene = as.character(gene)) %>%
    filter(endpoint %in% c("BL", "END"),!is.na(gene),gene != "")

  if (nrow(plot_variants) == 0) {
    stop(paste("final_variants contains no variants.","Check whether manual_keep is empty or use filter_7_seq_pass."))
  }

  #Prepare samples
  sample_info_plot <- samples %>%
    transmute(patient = as.character(patient),endpoint = toupper(as.character(endpoint))) %>%
    filter(endpoint %in% c("BL", "END")) %>%
    distinct(patient, endpoint) %>%
    mutate(
      sample_plot = paste(patient, endpoint, sep = "_"),
      timepoint = recode(
        endpoint,
        BL = "Baseline",
        END = "Post-radiotherapy")) %>%
    arrange(factor(endpoint, levels = c("BL", "END")),suppressWarnings(as.numeric(patient)),patient) %>%
    mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint,levels = c("Baseline", "Post-radiotherapy")))

  if (anyDuplicated(sample_info_plot$sample_plot)) {
    stop("Duplicated patient/timepoint combinations found in samples.")
  }

  #Classify mutations
  onco_data <- plot_variants %>%
    mutate(
      sample_plot = paste(patient, endpoint, sep = "_"),

      consequence_clean = str_to_lower(coalesce(as.character(consequence), "")),

      hgvsc_clean = str_to_lower(coalesce(as.character(hgvsc), "")),

      mutation_type = case_when(
        str_detect(consequence_clean,"frameshift_variant") ~ "Frameshift",

        str_detect(consequence_clean,"stop_gained") ~ "Stop gained",

        str_detect(
          consequence_clean,
          paste0(
            "splice_acceptor_variant|",
            "splice_donor_variant|",
            "splice_region_variant")) ~ "Splice",

        str_detect(consequence_clean,"missense_variant") ~ "Missense",

        str_detect(consequence_clean,"inframe_deletion") |
          (str_detect(hgvsc_clean, "del") & !str_detect(hgvsc_clean, "ins")) ~ "Deletion",

        str_detect(consequence_clean,"inframe_insertion") |
          str_detect(hgvsc_clean, "ins") ~ "Insertion",

        TRUE ~ "Other coding")) %>%
    filter(sample_plot %in% sample_info_plot$sample_plot) %>%
    distinct(gene,sample_plot,mutation_type) %>%
    group_by(gene, sample_plot) %>%
    summarise(mutation_type = paste(sort(unique(mutation_type)),collapse = ";"),.groups = "drop")

  #Build the gene-by-sample matrix
  genes_to_plot <- onco_data %>%
    count(gene, sort = TRUE) %>%
    pull(gene)

  onco_matrix <- expand_grid(gene = genes_to_plot,sample_plot = sample_info_plot$sample_plot) %>%
    left_join(onco_data,by = c("gene", "sample_plot")) %>%
    mutate(mutation_type = replace_na(mutation_type, "")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = sample_plot,values_from = mutation_type,values_fill = "")

  mat <- as.matrix(onco_matrix[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(mat) <- onco_matrix$gene

  mat <- mat[,sample_info_plot$sample_plot,drop = FALSE]

  #Order genes by frequency
  gene_frequency <- rowSums(mat != "")

  mat <- mat[order(-gene_frequency,rownames(mat)),,drop = FALSE]

  #Mutation drawing functions
  alter_fun <- list(
    background = alter_graphic("rect",width = 0.96,height = 0.88,fill = "#F2F2F2",col = "white",lwd = 0.6),

    Missense = alter_graphic(
      "rect",
      width = 0.96,
      height = 0.88,
      fill = mutation_colours["Missense"],
      col = "white",
      lwd = 0.6),

    Frameshift = alter_graphic(
      "rect",
      width = 0.96,
      height = 0.88,
      fill = mutation_colours["Frameshift"],
      col = "white",
      lwd = 0.6),

    `Stop gained` = alter_graphic(
      "rect",
      width = 0.96,
      height = 0.88,
      fill = mutation_colours["Stop gained"],
      col = "white",
      lwd = 0.6),

    Splice = alter_graphic("rect",width = 0.96,height = 0.88,fill = mutation_colours["Splice"],col = "white",lwd = 0.6),

    Deletion = alter_graphic(
      "rect",
      width = 0.96,
      height = 0.88,
      fill = mutation_colours["Deletion"],
      col = "white",
      lwd = 0.6),

    Insertion = alter_graphic(
      "rect",
      width = 0.96,
      height = 0.88,
      fill = mutation_colours["Insertion"],
      col = "white",
      lwd = 0.6),

    `Other coding` = alter_graphic(
      "rect",
      width = 0.96,
      height = 0.88,
      fill = mutation_colours["Other coding"],
      col = "white",
      lwd = 0.6))

  #Calculate timepoint percentages
  bl_columns <- sample_info_plot$endpoint == "BL"
  end_columns <- sample_info_plot$endpoint == "END"

  n_bl <- sum(bl_columns)
  n_end <- sum(end_columns)

  bl_percent <- if (n_bl > 0) {
    round(rowSums(mat[, bl_columns, drop = FALSE] != "") / n_bl * 100)
  } else {
    rep(NA_real_, nrow(mat))
  }

  end_percent <- if (n_end > 0) {
    round(rowSums(mat[, end_columns, drop = FALSE] != "") / n_end * 100)
  } else {
    rep(NA_real_, nrow(mat))
  }

  pct_mat <- cbind(Baseline = bl_percent,`Post-radiotherapy` = end_percent)

  rownames(pct_mat) <- rownames(mat)

  #Add timepoint annotations
  top_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Timepoint = sample_info_plot$timepoint,
    col = list(Timepoint = timepoint_colours),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = FALSE,
    simple_anno_size = unit(4, "mm"))

  timepoint_group <- factor(sample_info_plot$timepoint,levels = c("Baseline","Post-radiotherapy"))

  #Build the OncoPrint
  onco_height <- unit(max(40, nrow(mat) * 8),"mm")

  p_onco <- oncoPrint(
    mat,

    get_type = function(x) {
      if (is.na(x) || x == "") {
        character(0)
      } else {
        strsplit(x, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      }
    },

    alter_fun = alter_fun,
    alter_fun_is_vectorized = FALSE,
    col = mutation_colours,

    top_annotation = top_annotation,

    show_pct = FALSE,
    show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,

    remove_empty_columns = FALSE,
    remove_empty_rows = FALSE,

    column_order = seq_len(ncol(mat)),
    column_split = timepoint_group,
    column_gap = unit(4, "mm"),

    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13,fontface = "bold"),

    show_column_names = FALSE,

    show_row_names = TRUE,
    row_names_side = "left",
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12,fontface = "italic"),
    row_names_max_width = unit(30, "mm"),

    height = onco_height)

  #Add percentage columns
  pct_top <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Timepoint = factor(c("Baseline", "Post-radiotherapy"),levels = c("Baseline","Post-radiotherapy")),
    col = list(Timepoint = timepoint_colours),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    show_legend = FALSE,
    simple_anno_size = unit(4, "mm"))

  p_pct <- Heatmap(
    pct_mat,
    name = "Percentage",

    col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 100),c("white", "white")),

    top_annotation = pct_top,

    show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
    show_row_names = FALSE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,

    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,

    width = unit(25, "mm"),

    rect_gp = gpar(col = "white",fill = "white"),

    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      label <- ifelse(is.na(pct_mat[i, j]),"\u2013",paste0(pct_mat[i, j], "%"))

      grid.text(label,x = x,y = y,gp = gpar(fontsize = 11,fontface = "bold"))
    })

  #Build legends
  mutation_legend <- Legend(
    title = "Mutation type",
    at = names(mutation_colours),
    legend_gp = gpar(fill = unname(mutation_colours)),
    nrow = 2,
    by_row = TRUE,
    grid_width = unit(3.5, "mm"),
    grid_height = unit(3.5, "mm"),
    gap = unit(3, "mm"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10.5),
    title_gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 11,
      fontface = "bold"))

  timepoint_legend <- Legend(
    title = "Timepoint",
    at = names(timepoint_colours),
    legend_gp = gpar(fill = unname(timepoint_colours)),
    nrow = 1,
    grid_width = unit(3.5, "mm"),
    grid_height = unit(3.5, "mm"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10.5),
    title_gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 11,
      fontface = "bold"))

  #Draw the figure
  onco_figure <- p_onco + p_pct

  draw(
    onco_figure,
    heatmap_legend_list = list(mutation_legend,timepoint_legend),
    heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
    annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
    merge_legends = TRUE,
    padding = unit(
      c(4, 4, 4, 4),
      "mm"))

  #Save the figure
  figure_path <- file.path(path,"figures")
  dir.create(figure_path,showWarnings=FALSE)
  onco_output_path <- file.path(figure_path,"Figure_3_panel_A_oncoprint.png")

  png(
    onco_output_path,
    width = 12,
    height = max(5.5,2.5 + nrow(mat) * 0.25),
    units = "in",
    res = publication_dpi,
    bg = "white")

  draw(
    onco_figure,
    heatmap_legend_list = list(mutation_legend,timepoint_legend),
    heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
    annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
    merge_legends = TRUE,
    padding = unit(
      c(4, 4, 4, 4),
      "mm"))

  dev.off()

  #Combine manuscript panels
  onco_panel_grob <- grid::grid.grabExpr(
    draw(
      onco_figure,
      heatmap_legend_list = list(mutation_legend,timepoint_legend),
      heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
      annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
      merge_legends = TRUE,
      padding = unit(c(4,4,4,4),"mm")),
    wrap = TRUE)

  ctdna_oncoprint_detectability_main <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    A = patchwork::wrap_elements(full=onco_panel_grob),
    B = p_detect_overall,
    C = p_detect_gene,
    design = "AAAAAA\nBBCCCC",
    guides = "collect",
    heights = c(1.2,.65)) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels="A",theme=figure_tag_theme) &
    theme(legend.position="bottom")

  figure_path <- file.path(path,"figures")
  dir.create(figure_path,showWarnings=FALSE)
  ggsave(
    file.path(figure_path,"Figure_3_ctDNA_oncoprint_detectability.png"),
    ctdna_oncoprint_detectability_main,
    width=13,height=7.5,dpi=publication_dpi,bg="white")

  message("OncoPrint saved to: ",onco_output_path)

  ctdna_oncoprint_detectability_main
```

# 4 Clinical analysis

## 4.1 Prepare clinical data

### 4.1.1 Load and clean data

```{r load-clinical-data}
clinical_raw<-read_csv(file.path(path,"um_radiation_clinical_data.csv"),show_col_types=FALSE)

clinical_data<-clinical_raw%>%
  transmute(
    patient=as.character(pid),
    age=as.numeric(age),
    sex=str_to_upper(str_trim(as.character(sex))),
    rurality=na_if(str_to_title(str_replace_all(str_trim(as.character(rurality)),"_"," ")),""),
    eye=str_to_upper(str_trim(as.character(eye))),
    tumour_location=na_if(str_to_title(str_trim(as.character(melansubtype))),""),
    apical=as.numeric(apical),
    lbd=as.numeric(lbd),
    recorded_volume=as.numeric(volume),
    tissue_risk=na_if(
      str_to_title(str_trim(as.character(risk))),""))%>%
  mutate(
    sex=factor(sex,levels=c("F","M")),
    eye=factor(eye,levels=c("L","R")),
    #Semi-ellipsoid tumour-volume estimate
    volume=if_else(!is.na(apical)&apical>0&!is.na(lbd)&lbd>0,(pi/6)*apical*lbd*(0.85*lbd),NA_real_),
    tissue_risk=factor(tissue_risk,levels=c("Low","High")))%>%
  select(-recorded_volume)

clinical_data
```

### 4.1.2 Check patients and missing data

```{r check-clinical-data}
clinical_check<-clinical_data%>%
  summarise(rows=n(),patients=n_distinct(patient),duplicate_patients=sum(duplicated(patient)))

clinical_check

clinical_availability<-clinical_data%>%
  summarise(across(-patient,~sum(!is.na(.x))))%>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),names_to="variable",values_to="available")%>%
  mutate(
    variable=recode(
      variable,
      age="Age",
      sex="Sex",
      rurality="Rurality",
      eye="Affected eye",
      tumour_location="Tumour location",
      apical="Apical height",
      lbd="Largest basal diameter",
      volume="Calculated tumour volume (mm\u00B3)",
      tissue_risk="Tissue risk group"),
    total=nrow(clinical_data),
    missing=total-available,
    available_percent=round(100*available/total,1),
    missing_percent=round(100*missing/total,1))%>%
  select(
    Variable=variable,
    Total=total,
    Available=available,
    `Available (%)`=available_percent,
    Missing=missing,
    `Missing (%)`=missing_percent)

clinical_availability

## 4.2 Build the clinical ctDNA dataset

### 4.2.1 Patient-level detectability and maximum VAF

```{r build-clinical-ctdna-data}
patient_vaf<-final_variants%>%
  transmute(
    patient=as.character(patient),
    endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)),
    variant_id=as.character(variant_id),
    molecular_vaf_percent=as.numeric(molecular_vaf_percent))%>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END"))%>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,variant_id,.keep_all=TRUE)%>%
  group_by(patient,endpoint)%>%
  summarise(
    ctdna_detected=TRUE,
    n_variants=n_distinct(variant_id,na.rm=TRUE),
    max_vaf=if(all(is.na(molecular_vaf_percent))) NA_real_ else
      max(molecular_vaf_percent,na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop")

clinical_ctdna<-samples%>%
  transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)))%>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END"))%>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint)%>%
  semi_join(clinical_data,by="patient")%>%
  left_join(patient_vaf,by=c("patient","endpoint"))%>%
  mutate(
    ctdna_detected=replace_na(ctdna_detected,FALSE),
    n_variants=replace_na(n_variants,0L),
    ctdna_status=factor(ifelse(ctdna_detected,"Detected","Not detected"),levels=c("Not detected","Detected")),
    timepoint=recode(endpoint,BL="Baseline",END="Post-radiotherapy"),
    timepoint=factor(
      timepoint,
      levels=c("Baseline","Post-radiotherapy")))%>%
  left_join(clinical_data,by="patient")%>%
  arrange(patient,endpoint)

clinical_timepoint_colours<-timepoint_colours

clinical_ctdna_colours<-c("Not detected"="grey80","Detected"=unname(unified_colours["Baseline"]))

tissue_risk_colours<-c("Low"=unname(unified_colours["Baseline"]),"High"=unname(unified_colours["Post-radiotherapy"]))

clinical_ctdna%>%
  count(timepoint,ctdna_status)
```

### 4.2.2 Paired detectability

```{r clinical-detectability-summary}
ctdna_timepoint_summary<-clinical_ctdna%>%
  group_by(timepoint)%>%
  summarise(
    patients=n(),
    detected=sum(ctdna_detected),
    not_detected=sum(!ctdna_detected),
    detected_percent=round(100*mean(ctdna_detected),1),
    .groups="drop")

ctdna_timepoint_summary

clinical_BL<-clinical_ctdna%>%
  filter(endpoint=="BL")

clinical_END<-clinical_ctdna%>%
  filter(endpoint=="END")

clinical_detectability_wide<-clinical_ctdna%>%
  select(patient,endpoint,ctdna_detected)%>%
  distinct()%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=endpoint,values_from=ctdna_detected)%>%
  drop_na(BL,END)

clinical_gained<-sum(!clinical_detectability_wide$BL& clinical_detectability_wide$END)

clinical_lost<-sum(clinical_detectability_wide$BL& !clinical_detectability_wide$END)

clinical_discordant<-clinical_gained+clinical_lost

clinical_detectability_p<-if(clinical_discordant==0) 1 else
  binom.test(clinical_gained,clinical_discordant,p=0.5)$p.value

clinical_detectability_table<-table(
  Baseline=factor(clinical_detectability_wide$BL,levels=c(FALSE,TRUE),labels=c("Not detected","Detected")),
  `Post-radiotherapy`=factor(
    clinical_detectability_wide$END,
    levels=c(FALSE,TRUE),
    labels=c("Not detected","Detected")))

clinical_detectability_table

tibble(
  paired_patients=nrow(clinical_detectability_wide),
  gained=clinical_gained,
  lost=clinical_lost,
  exact_p_value=clinical_detectability_p)
```

## 4.3 Clinical features and ctDNA

### 4.3.1 Clinical-feature table

```{r clinical-feature-table}
clinical_table_definitions<-tibble::tribble(
  ~row_order,~variable,~Characteristic,~summary_type,~reported_level,~fdr_family,
  1L,"age","Age, years","continuous",NA_character_,"Other",
  2L,"sex","Sex: male","categorical","M","Other",
  3L,"eye","Affected eye: left","categorical","L","Other",
  4L,"apical","Apical height, mm","continuous",NA_character_,"Tumour size",
  5L,"lbd","Largest basal diameter, mm","continuous",NA_character_,"Tumour size",
  6L,"volume","Calculated tumour volume, mm\u00B3","continuous",NA_character_,"Tumour size",
  7L,"tissue_risk","Tissue risk: high","categorical","High","Other")

clinical_summary_value<-function(data,variable,summary_type,reported_level){
  values<-data[[variable]]
  available<-sum(!is.na(values))

  if(available==0) return("\u2014")

  if(summary_type=="continuous"){
    observed<-as.numeric(values[!is.na(values)])
    return(paste0(
      sprintf("%.1f (%.1f\u2013%.1f)",median(observed),quantile(observed,0.25),quantile(observed,0.75)),
      " [",length(observed),"]"))}

  numerator<-sum(as.character(values)==reported_level,na.rm=TRUE)
  sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)",numerator,available,100*numerator/available)
}

clinical_compact_summary_grid<-tidyr::crossing(
  timepoint=c("Baseline","Post-radiotherapy"),
  ctdna_status=c("Not detected","Detected"),
  row_order=clinical_table_definitions$row_order)

clinical_compact_summaries<-purrr::pmap_dfr(
  clinical_compact_summary_grid,
  function(timepoint,ctdna_status,row_order){
    definition<-clinical_table_definitions%>%
      filter(.data$row_order==.env$row_order)
    group_data<-clinical_ctdna%>%
      filter(as.character(.data$timepoint)==.env$timepoint,as.character(.data$ctdna_status)==.env$ctdna_status)

    tibble(
      row_order=row_order,
      timepoint=timepoint,
      ctdna_status=ctdna_status,
      summary=clinical_summary_value(
        group_data,
        definition$variable[[1]],
        definition$summary_type[[1]],
        definition$reported_level[[1]]))
  })%>%
  mutate(summary_column=case_when(
    timepoint=="Baseline"&ctdna_status=="Not detected"~"baseline_not_detected",
    timepoint=="Baseline"&ctdna_status=="Detected"~"baseline_detected",
    timepoint=="Post-radiotherapy"&ctdna_status=="Not detected"~"post_not_detected",
    TRUE~"post_detected"))%>%
  select(row_order,summary_column,summary)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=summary_column,values_from=summary)

clinical_compact_test_p<-function(data,variable,summary_type,timepoint){
  test_data<-data%>%
    filter(as.character(.data$timepoint)==.env$timepoint,!is.na(.data[[variable]]),!is.na(.data$ctdna_status))

  if(n_distinct(test_data$ctdna_status)<2) return(NA_real_)

  if(summary_type=="continuous"){
    grouped_values<-split(as.numeric(test_data[[variable]]),droplevels(test_data$ctdna_status))
    return(suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(
      grouped_values[[1]],
      grouped_values[[2]],
      exact=FALSE)$p.value))}

  test_table<-table(droplevels(test_data[[variable]]),droplevels(test_data$ctdna_status))
  if(any(dim(test_table)<2)) return(NA_real_)
  fisher.test(test_table)$p.value
}

clinical_compact_test_grid<-tidyr::crossing(
  timepoint=c("Baseline","Post-radiotherapy"),
  row_order=clinical_table_definitions$row_order)

clinical_compact_tests<-purrr::pmap_dfr(
  clinical_compact_test_grid,
  function(timepoint,row_order){
    definition<-clinical_table_definitions%>%
      filter(.data$row_order==.env$row_order)
    tibble(
      row_order=row_order,
      timepoint=timepoint,
      fdr_family=definition$fdr_family[[1]],
      p_value=clinical_compact_test_p(
        clinical_ctdna,
        definition$variable[[1]],
        definition$summary_type[[1]],
        timepoint))
  })%>%
  group_by(timepoint)%>%
  mutate(FDR={
    adjusted<-rep(NA_real_,n())
    family_rows<-fdr_family=="Tumour size"&!is.na(p_value)
    adjusted[family_rows]<-p.adjust(p_value[family_rows],method="BH")
    adjusted
  })%>%
  ungroup()

clinical_p_display<-function(x){
  ifelse(is.na(x),"\u2014",ifelse(x<0.001,"<0.001",sprintf("%.3f",x)))
}

clinical_compact_tests_wide<-clinical_compact_tests%>%
  mutate(
    stat_prefix=ifelse(timepoint=="Baseline","baseline","post"),
    p_display=clinical_p_display(p_value),
    fdr_display=clinical_p_display(FDR))%>%
  select(row_order,stat_prefix,p_display,fdr_display)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=stat_prefix,values_from=c(p_display,fdr_display),names_glue="{stat_prefix}_{.value}")

clinical_compact_table<-clinical_table_definitions%>%
  select(row_order,Characteristic)%>%
  left_join(clinical_compact_summaries,by="row_order")%>%
  left_join(clinical_compact_tests_wide,by="row_order")%>%
  arrange(row_order)%>%
  select(
    Characteristic,
    baseline_not_detected,
    baseline_detected,
    baseline_p_display,
    baseline_fdr_display,
    post_not_detected,
    post_detected,
    post_p_display,
    post_fdr_display)

clinical_total_n<-n_distinct(clinical_ctdna$patient)
baseline_not_detected_n<-sum(clinical_ctdna$timepoint=="Baseline"& clinical_ctdna$ctdna_status=="Not detected")
baseline_detected_n<-sum(clinical_ctdna$timepoint=="Baseline"& clinical_ctdna$ctdna_status=="Detected")
post_not_detected_n<-sum(clinical_ctdna$timepoint=="Post-radiotherapy"& clinical_ctdna$ctdna_status=="Not detected")
post_detected_n<-sum(clinical_ctdna$timepoint=="Post-radiotherapy"& clinical_ctdna$ctdna_status=="Detected")

clinical_detectability_gt<-clinical_compact_table%>%
  gt::gt()%>%
  gt::cols_label(
    Characteristic=gt::md("**Characteristic**"),
    baseline_not_detected=gt::md(paste0("**ctDNA\u2212**<br>N=",baseline_not_detected_n)),
    baseline_detected=gt::md(paste0("**ctDNA+**<br>N=",baseline_detected_n)),
    baseline_p_display=gt::md("***P***"),

    post_not_detected=gt::md(paste0("**ctDNA\u2212**<br>N=",post_not_detected_n)),
    post_detected=gt::md(paste0("**ctDNA+**<br>N=",post_detected_n)),

  gt::tab_spanner(
    label=gt::md("**Post-radiotherapy**"),
    columns=c(
      post_not_detected,
      post_detected,
      post_p_display,
      post_fdr_display))%>%
  gt::tab_header(
    title=gt::md("**Supplementary Table S3. Clinical variables by ctDNA detectability**"),
    subtitle=gt::md(paste0(
      "Clinical subset, N=",clinical_total_n,
      "; ctDNA detected in ",baseline_detected_n,"/",clinical_total_n,
      " (",sprintf("%.1f",100*baseline_detected_n/clinical_total_n),

Clinical variables are baseline/static covariates; ctDNA status is timepoint-specific. Missing values were not imputed.*"))%>%

### 4.4.3 Maximum VAF and clinical features

```{r max-vaf-clinical-correlations}
spearman_row<-function(data,var,label,tp){
  d<-data%>%
    filter(timepoint==tp,!is.na(.data[[var]]))

  if(nrow(d)<3|n_distinct(d$max_vaf)<2|n_distinct(d[[var]])<2){
    return(tibble(
      timepoint=tp,
      variable=label,
      n=nrow(d),
      rho=NA_real_,
      p_value=NA_real_))}

  test<-suppressWarnings(cor.test(d$max_vaf,d[[var]],method="spearman",exact=FALSE))

  tibble(
    timepoint=tp,
    variable=label,
    n=nrow(d),
    rho=unname(test$estimate),
    p_value=test$p.value)}

max_vaf_correlations<-bind_rows(
  spearman_row(clinical_vaf_positive,"age","Age","Baseline"),
  spearman_row(clinical_vaf_positive,"apical","Apical height","Baseline"),
  spearman_row(clinical_vaf_positive,"lbd","Largest basal diameter","Baseline"),
  spearman_row(clinical_vaf_positive,"volume","Calculated tumour volume (mm\u00B3)","Baseline"),
  spearman_row(clinical_vaf_positive,"age","Age","Post-radiotherapy"),
  spearman_row(clinical_vaf_positive,"apical","Apical height","Post-radiotherapy"),
  spearman_row(clinical_vaf_positive,"lbd","Largest basal diameter","Post-radiotherapy"),
  spearman_row(
    clinical_vaf_positive,"volume","Calculated tumour volume (mm\u00B3)",
    "Post-radiotherapy"))%>%
  group_by(timepoint)%>%
  mutate(FDR=p.adjust(p_value,method="BH"))%>%
  ungroup()

max_vaf_correlations

max_vaf_correlations_gt<-max_vaf_correlations%>%
  mutate(timepoint=factor(timepoint,levels=c("Baseline","Post-radiotherapy")))%>%
  select(Timepoint=timepoint,`Clinical feature`=variable,N=n,`Spearman rho`=rho,`P value`=p_value,FDR)%>%
  gt::gt(groupname_col="Timepoint")%>%
  gt::fmt_number(columns=c(`Spearman rho`,`P value`,FDR),decimals=3)%>%
  gt::sub_missing(missing_text="-")%>%
  gt::tab_header(
    title="Association of maximum VAF with continuous clinical features",
    subtitle="ctDNA-positive samples only")%>%
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note=gt::md(
      "*Spearman correlations were calculated separately at each timepoint. FDR uses Benjamini\u2013Hochberg correction within each timepoint.*"))

## 4.5 Prognostic genes and tissue risk

### 4.5.1 Results by timepoint

```{r prognostic-genes-by-timepoint}
prognostic_calls<-final_variants%>%
  transmute(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(as.character(endpoint)),gene=as.character(gene))%>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END"),gene%in%c("BAP1","SF3B1","EIF1AX"))%>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,gene)%>%
  group_by(patient,endpoint)%>%
  summarise(genes=paste(sort(gene),collapse="; "),n_genes=n_distinct(gene),.groups="drop")%>%
  mutate(plasma_marker=case_when(
    n_genes>1~"Multiple prognostic-gene variants detected",
    genes=="BAP1"~"BAP1 variant detected",
    genes=="SF3B1"~"SF3B1 variant detected",
    genes=="EIF1AX"~"EIF1AX variant detected"))

plasma_prognosis<-clinical_ctdna%>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint,timepoint,tissue_risk)%>%
  left_join(prognostic_calls,by=c("patient","endpoint"))%>%
  mutate(
    genes=replace_na(genes,"-"),
    n_genes=replace_na(n_genes,0L),
    plasma_marker=replace_na(plasma_marker,"No prognostic-gene variant detected"),
    plasma_marker=factor(
      plasma_marker,
      levels=c(
        "No prognostic-gene variant detected",
        "BAP1 variant detected",
        "SF3B1 variant detected",
        "EIF1AX variant detected",
        "Multiple prognostic-gene variants detected")))%>%
  arrange(timepoint,patient)

plasma_prognosis_summary<-plasma_prognosis%>%
  count(timepoint,plasma_marker,name="n",.drop=FALSE)%>%
  group_by(timepoint)%>%
  mutate(percent=100*n/sum(n),result=paste0(n," (",round(percent,1),"%)"))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  select(plasma_marker,timepoint,result)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=timepoint,values_from=result,values_fill="0 (0.0%)")

plasma_prognosis_gt<-plasma_prognosis_summary%>%
  gt::gt()%>%
  gt::cols_label(
    plasma_marker="Plasma prognostic-gene result",
    Baseline="Baseline",
    `Post-radiotherapy`="Post-radiotherapy")%>%
  gt::tab_header(title="Plasma prognostic-gene variants by timepoint",subtitle="Patients in the clinical cohort")%>%
  gt::cols_align(align="left",columns=plasma_marker)%>%
  gt::cols_align(align="center",columns=c(Baseline,`Post-radiotherapy`))%>%
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note=gt::md(
      "*No prognostic-gene variant detected in plasma does not indicate a low-risk tumour.*"))

plasma_prognosis_gt

plasma_prognosis_ever<-final_variants%>%

  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END"),gene%in%c("BAP1","SF3B1","EIF1AX"))%>%

    marker_positive=sum(marker_status=="Any marker detected"),
    percent_positive=round(100*marker_positive/patients,1),
    .groups="drop")

risk_marker_table<-table(
  Tissue_risk=risk_plasma_data$tissue_risk,
  Plasma_marker=factor(
    risk_plasma_data$marker_status,
    levels=c("No marker detected","Any marker detected")))

risk_marker_test<-fisher.test(risk_marker_table)

risk_marker_summary
risk_marker_table
risk_marker_test
```

### 4.5.5 Paired change in prognostic-gene detection

```{r prognostic-gene-change}
marker_change<-plasma_prognosis%>%
  mutate(marker_detected= plasma_marker!="No prognostic-gene variant detected")%>%
  select(patient,endpoint,marker_detected)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=endpoint,values_from=marker_detected)%>%
  drop_na(BL,END)

marker_transition_table<-table(
  Baseline=factor(marker_change$BL,levels=c(FALSE,TRUE),labels=c("Not detected","Detected")),
  `Post-radiotherapy`=factor(
    marker_change$END,
    levels=c(FALSE,TRUE),
    labels=c("Not detected","Detected")))

marker_gained<-sum(!marker_change$BL&marker_change$END)
marker_lost<-sum(marker_change$BL&!marker_change$END)
marker_discordant<-marker_gained+marker_lost

marker_change_p<-if(marker_discordant==0) 1 else
  binom.test(marker_gained,marker_discordant,p=0.5)$p.value

marker_transition_table

tibble(gained=marker_gained,lost=marker_lost,discordant=marker_discordant,exact_p_value=marker_change_p)
```

pre_analytical<-readxl::read_excel(file.path(path,"um_radiation_pre_analytical.xlsx"),sheet="Sheet1")%>%

pre_analytical%>%
  summarise(rows=n(),patients=n_distinct(patient),missing_cfdna=sum(is.na(cfdna_ng_ul)))

  count(patient,endpoint)%>%
  filter(n>1)

cfdna_duplicates

### 4.6.2 Paired cfDNA summary

```{r paired-cfdna-summary}
paired_cfdna<-pre_analytical%>%
  select(patient,endpoint,cfdna_ng_ul)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=endpoint,values_from=cfdna_ng_ul)%>%
  drop_na(BL,END)

cfdna_plot_data<-paired_cfdna%>%
  pivot_longer(c(BL,END),names_to="endpoint",values_to="cfdna_ng_ul")%>%
  mutate(
    timepoint=recode(endpoint,BL="Baseline",END="Post-radiotherapy"),
    timepoint=factor(
      timepoint,
      levels=c("Baseline","Post-radiotherapy")))

cfdna_summary<-cfdna_plot_data%>%
  group_by(timepoint)%>%
  summarise(
    n=n(),
    median=median(cfdna_ng_ul),
    Q1=quantile(cfdna_ng_ul,0.25),
    Q3=quantile(cfdna_ng_ul,0.75),
    min=min(cfdna_ng_ul),
    max=max(cfdna_ng_ul),
    .groups="drop")

cfdna_summary_display<-cfdna_summary%>%
  mutate(
    `Median (IQR), ng/uL`=paste0(round(median,3)," (",round(Q1,3),"\u2013",round(Q3,3),")"),
    `Range, ng/uL`=paste0(
      round(min,3),"\u2013",
      round(max,3)))%>%
  select(Timepoint=timepoint,N=n,`Median (IQR), ng/uL`,`Range, ng/uL`)

cfdna_summary_display

cfdna_test<-wilcox.test(paired_cfdna$BL,paired_cfdna$END,paired=TRUE,exact=FALSE)

cfdna_test
```

### 4.8.1 Prepare summaries

```{r assemble-supplementary-statistics}
detectability_description<-ctdna_timepoint_summary%>%

detectability_description<-paste0(detectability_description,"; gained=",clinical_gained,"; lost=",clinical_lost)

size_description<-size_summary%>%
  mutate(

      short_status,": ",
      round(median,1)," (",
      round(Q1,1),"\u2013",
      round(Q3,1),"), n=",n))%>%
  group_by(timepoint,measure)%>%
  summarise(estimate=paste(text,collapse="; "),.groups="drop")

size_rows<-size_tests%>%
  left_join(size_description,by=c("timepoint","measure"))%>%
  transmute(

correlation_rows<-max_vaf_correlations%>%

minimum_size_rows<-minimum_detected_size%>%

minimum_vaf_rows<-minimum_detected_vaf%>%

    Estimate=paste0("Minimum observed=",sprintf("%.3f",max_vaf),"%"),

    p_value=NA_real_,
    FDR=NA_real_)

# 5 Sensitivity analysis

```{r two-molecule-sensitivity}
#Store the original count
sens_original_n <- nrow(final_variants)

#Keep calls with at least two ALT molecules
sens_two_plus <- final_variants %>%
  mutate(qc_alt_molecules=as.numeric(qc_alt_molecules)) %>%
  filter(qc_alt_molecules>=2)

#Patients with both timepoints
sens_paired_patients <- samples %>%
  mutate(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(endpoint)) %>%
  filter(endpoint%in%c("BL","END")) %>%
  distinct(patient,endpoint) %>%
  count(patient) %>%
  filter(n==2) %>%
  pull(patient)

#Calculate detectability and tests
sens_test <- function(variants,label) {

  positives <- variants %>%
    mutate(patient=as.character(patient),endpoint=toupper(endpoint)) %>%
    filter(patient%in%sens_paired_patients,endpoint%in%c("BL","END")) %>%
    distinct(patient,endpoint)

  total <- length(sens_paired_patients)

  bl_positive <- n_distinct(positives$patient[positives$endpoint=="BL"])

  end_positive <- n_distinct(positives$patient[positives$endpoint=="END"])

  #Rows are timepoints; columns are detection states
  test_table <- matrix(
    c(bl_positive,total-bl_positive,end_positive,total-end_positive),
    nrow=2,
    byrow=TRUE,
    dimnames=list(
      Timepoint=c("Baseline","Post-radiotherapy"),
      Detection=c("Detected","Not detected")))

  tibble(
    Analysis=label,
    `Variant calls`=nrow(variants),
    Baseline=sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)",bl_positive,total,100*bl_positive/total),
    `Post-radiotherapy`=sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)",end_positive,total,100*end_positive/total),
    `Fisher P`=round(fisher.test(test_table)$p.value,3),
    `Chi-square P`=round(
      chisq.test(test_table,correct=TRUE)$p.value,
      3))
}

#Compare analyses
sens_results <- bind_rows(
  sens_test(final_variants,"Original: all retained calls"),
  sens_test(
    sens_two_plus,
    "Sensitivity: 2+ ALT molecules"))

sens_results

#Confirm the source data did not change
stopifnot(nrow(final_variants)==sens_original_n)

message("PASS: final_variants was not modified.")
```
